text: An approval number shall be assigned to each vehicle or ESA type approved in accordance with Schedule 4 of the 1958 Agreement (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3).
An approval mark as described in paragraph 5.3 shall be affixed to every vehicle conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.
condition: vehicle approved under UN R10

text: An approval mark as described in paragraph 5.3 shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.
condition: ESA approved under UN R10

text: No marking is required for electrical/electronic systems built into vehicles which are approved as units.
condition: electrical/electronic system built into a vehicle approved as a unit

text: The international approval mark shall be affixed in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form on each vehicle conforming to the type approved under this Regulation.
The approval mark shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
The approval mark shall comprise the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1.
Markings on ESAs in conformity with paragraph 5.3 need not be visible when the ESA is installed in the vehicle.
condition: ESA installed in the vehicle

text: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
condition: configurations other than REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: A vehicle shall be tested for radiated emissions and for immunity to radiated disturbances; no tests for conducted emissions or immunity to conducted disturbances are required for vehicle type approval.
condition: configurations other than REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions and for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
condition: configurations other than REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: Before testing, the Technical Service shall prepare a test plan in conjunction with the manufacturer, which contains at least mode of operation, stimulated function(s), monitored function(s), pass/fail criterion(criteria) and intended emissions.

Depending on the intended operating conditions of the propulsion system, the test plan shall define the minimum number of steady state operating conditions of the vehicle, selectable by the driver or by the control system.

The test conditions shall consider multiple propulsion system operating strategies which can be activated permanently by the driver or the vehicle control system and shall be based on documentation provided in Annexes 2A and 2B (e.g. risk analysis).

The broadband electromagnetic radiation generated by the vehicle representative of its type shall be measured using the method described in Annex 4; the method of measurement shall be defined by the vehicle manufacturer in accordance with the Technical Service.
The vehicle broadband radiated emission limit shall be 32 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band.
condition: measurement per Annex 4 with vehicle-to-antenna spacing of 10.0 ± 0.2 m

text: The vehicle broadband radiated emission limit shall be 32 to 43 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band, increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 2.
condition: measurement per Annex 4 with vehicle-to-antenna spacing of 10.0 ± 0.2 m

text: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the vehicle broadband radiated emission limit remains constant at 43 dB microvolts/m.
condition: measurement per Annex 4 with vehicle-to-antenna spacing of 10.0 ± 0.2 m

text: The vehicle broadband radiated emission limit shall be 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band.

text: The vehicle broadband radiated emission limit shall be 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz frequency band, increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 3.

text: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the vehicle broadband radiated emission limit remains constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.

text: On the vehicle representative of its type, the measured broadband values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.

The narrowband electromagnetic radiation generated by the vehicle representative of its type shall be measured using the method described in Annex 5, defined by the vehicle manufacturer in accordance with the Technical Service.
The vehicle narrowband radiated emission limit shall be 28 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 230 MHz frequency band.

text: The vehicle narrowband radiated emission limit shall be 35 dB microvolts/m in the 230 to 1,000 MHz frequency band.

The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the vehicle representative of its type shall be tested by the method described in Annex 6.

For vehicle immunity tests per Annex 6 in accordance with ISO 11451-2, the field strength shall be 30 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 25 volts/m over the whole 20 to 2,000 MHz frequency band.

text: For vehicle immunity tests per Annex 6 in accordance with ISO 11451-2, the field strength shall be 10 volts/m in over 90 per cent of the 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band and a minimum of 8 volts/m over the whole 2,000 to 6,000 MHz frequency band.

text: The vehicle representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 6, there is no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions", according to paragraph 2.1 of Annex 6.

text: The ESA narrowband radiated emission limit shall be 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.

text: The ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there is no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".

The immunity of the ESA representative of its type to transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines shall be tested according to ISO 16750-2 for the starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.

The starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1, and the Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.

For the starting profile, the ESA shall meet immunity test level II (12 V system) or II (24 V system) for 10 pulses with functional status class B for ESA related to immunity related functions which shall be operational during engine start phases, class C for other ESA related to immunity related functions, and class D for ESA not related to immunity related functions.
condition: only ESAs that could be installed in vehicles with internal combustion engines started with a 12V/24V starter motor

text: For pulse 1, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -75 V (12V system) or -450 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC III for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity.

For pulse 2a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +37 V (12V system) or +37 V (24V system) for 500 pulses with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity.

For pulse 2b, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +10 V (12V system) or +20 V (24V system) for 10 pulses with FPSC II for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity.

For pulse 3a, the ESA shall meet immunity test level -112 V (12V system) or -150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity.

For pulse 3b, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +75 V (12V system) or +150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity.

text: RF transmitters shall be tested in the transmit mode.

text: For pulse 3b, the ESA shall meet immunity test level +75 V (12V system) or +150 V (24V system) for 1 h with FPSC I for functions related to immunity and FPSC III for functions not related to immunity.
condition: REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: Vehicles and/or ESA intended to be used in REESS charging mode connected to a DC-charging station with a DC network cable shorter than 30 m do not have to fulfil paragraphs 7.5., 7.8., 7.9., 7.13., 7.15. and 7.16., provided the manufacturer provides a statement that the vehicle and/or ESA can be used in REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid only with cables shorter than 30 m.
condition: If exemption for DC network cable shorter than 30 m is used
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The statement that the vehicle and/or ESA can be used in REESS charging mode only with cables shorter than 30 m shall be made publicly available following the type approval.
condition: If exemption for DC network cable shorter than 30 m is used
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: Vehicles and/or ESA intended to be used in REESS charging mode connected to a local/private DC-charging station without additional participants do not have to fulfil paragraphs 7.5., 7.8., 7.9., 7.13., 7.15. and 7.16., provided the manufacturer provides a statement that the vehicle and/or ESA can be used in REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid only with a local/private DC charging station without additional participants.
condition: If exemption for local/private DC-charging station is used
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The statement that the vehicle and/or ESA can be used only with a local/private DC charging station without additional participants shall be made publicly available following the type approval.
condition: If exemption for local/private DC-charging station is used
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The vehicle approval may be extended without further testing for an additional or substitutional electrical/electronic system or ESA only if it has already received approval under this Regulation and will be installed in accordance with any conditions attached thereto.
condition: Vehicle installation already type approved; additional or substitutional ESA fitted

text: The additional or substitutional electrical/electronic system or ESA shall be considered as part of the vehicle for conformity of production purposes.
condition: Approval extended without further testing

text: Where additional or substitution part(s) have not received approval under this Regulation and testing is considered necessary, the whole vehicle shall be deemed to conform only if the new or revised part(s) can be shown to conform to the relevant requirements of paragraph 6. and, if applicable, paragraph 7., or if in a comparative test the new part can be shown not to be likely to adversely affect the conformity of the vehicle type.
condition: Additional or substitution part not approved under this Regulation and testing considered necessary

text: The addition to an approved vehicle of standard domestic or business equipment, other than mobile communication equipment, which conforms to other Regulations and whose installation, substitution or removal is according to the recommendations of the equipment and vehicle manufacturers, shall not invalidate the vehicle approval.
condition: Standard domestic or business equipment other than mobile communication equipment

text: Communication equipment may be fitted by vehicle manufacturers in accordance with suitable installation guidelines developed by the vehicle manufacturer and/or manufacturer(s) of such communication equipment.
condition: Fitting of communication equipment

text: The vehicle manufacturer shall provide evidence (if requested by the test authority) that vehicle performance is not adversely affected by such transmitters, e.g. a statement that the power levels and installation are such that the immunity levels of this Regulation offer sufficient protection when subject to transmission alone.
condition: If requested by the test authority

text: The conformity of production procedures shall comply with those set out in Schedule 1 of the 1958 Agreement (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3), with the requirements of paragraphs 9.1 to 9.3.

Vehicles or components or ESAs approved under this Regulation shall be so manufactured as to conform to the type approved by meeting the requirements set forth in paragraph 6. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.

Conformity of production of the vehicle or component or separate technical unit shall be checked on the basis of the data contained in the communication form(s) for type approval set out in Annex 3A and/or 3B.
If the Type Approval Authority is not satisfied with the checking procedure of the manufacturer, paragraphs 9.3.1., 9.3.2. and 9.3.3. shall apply.
condition: Type Approval Authority not satisfied with manufacturer's checking procedure

text: For a vehicle taken from the series, broadband and narrowband radiated emission levels measured shall not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.2.2.1., 6.2.2.2., 6.3.2.1., 6.3.2.2. and, if applicable, 7.2.2.1. and 7.2.2.2.
condition: Conformity verification of series vehicle under paragraph 9.3

text: For a component or ESA taken from the series, broadband and narrowband radiated emission levels measured shall not exceed by more than 4 dB (60 per cent) the reference limits prescribed in paragraphs 6.5.2.1., 6.6.2.1. and, if applicable, 7.10.2.1.
condition: Conformity verification of series ESA under paragraph 9.3

text: A vehicle taken from the series shall not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle which could be observed by the driver or other road user when in the state defined in Annex 6, paragraph 4., and subjected to a field strength up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.4.2.1. and, if applicable, 7.7.2.1.
condition: Conformity verification of series vehicle under paragraph 9.3

text: An ESA taken from the series shall not exhibit any degradation relating to the direct control of the vehicle when subjected to a field strength up to 80 per cent of the reference limits prescribed in paragraph 6.8.2.1. and, if applicable, 7.18.2.1.
condition: Conformity verification of series ESA under paragraph 9.3

text: A component or STU taken from the series shall show no degradation of performance of immunity related functions up to the levels given in paragraph 6.9.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.19.1.
condition: Conformity verification of series component/STU under paragraph 9.3

text: A component or STU taken from the series shall not exceed the transient conducted emission levels given in paragraph 6.7.1. and, if applicable, paragraph 7.17.1.
condition: Conformity verification of series component/STU under paragraph 9.3

text: The approval granted for a type of vehicle, component or separate technical unit may be withdrawn if the requirements of paragraph 6. and, if applicable, paragraph 7. are not complied with or if the selected vehicles fail to pass the tests provided therein.
condition: Non-conformity of production

text: A Party withdrawing an approval it has previously granted shall forthwith notify the other Contracting Parties applying this Regulation by means of a communication form conforming to the model in Annexes 3A and 3B.
condition: If an approval is withdrawn

text: Every modification of the vehicle or ESA type shall be notified to the Type Approval Authority which granted approval of the vehicle type.
condition: Modification of the vehicle or ESA type

text: Upon notification of a modification, the Type Approval Authority may consider that the modifications made are unlikely to have an appreciable adverse effect and that in any case the vehicle or ESA still meets the requirements.
condition: Modification notified

text: Upon notification of a modification, the Type Approval Authority may require a further test report from the Technical Service responsible for conducting the tests.
condition: Modification notified

text: Notice of confirmation of approval or of refusal of approval, accompanied by particulars of the modifications, shall be communicated by the procedure indicated in paragraph 4. to the Parties to the Agreement applying this Regulation.
condition: Modification of approved type

text: The Type Approval Authority granting the approval extension shall assign a serial number to the extension and notify the other Parties to the 1958 Agreement applying this Regulation by means of a communication form conforming to the models in Annexes 3A and 3B.
condition: Approval extension granted

text: Appendix 2: Vehicle broadband reference limits at 10 m antenna-vehicle separation for a 120 kHz bandwidth shall be E = 32 dBµV/m (30-75 MHz), E = 32 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m (75-400 MHz) and E = 43 dBµV/m (400-1,000 MHz).
condition: Vehicle-to-antenna spacing 10 m

text: Appendix 3: Vehicle broadband reference limits at 3 m antenna-vehicle separation for a 120 kHz bandwidth shall be E = 42 dBµV/m (30-75 MHz), E = 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m (75-400 MHz) and E = 53 dBµV/m (400-1,000 MHz).
condition: Vehicle-to-antenna spacing 3 m

text: Appendix 4: Vehicle narrowband reference limits at 10 m antenna-vehicle separation shall be E = 28 dBµV/m (30-230 MHz) and E = 35 dBµV/m (230-1,000 MHz), measured with a 120 kHz bandwidth.
condition: Vehicle-to-antenna spacing 10 m

text: Appendix 5: Vehicle narrowband reference limits at 3 m antenna-vehicle separation for a 120 kHz bandwidth shall be E = 38 dBµV/m (30-230 MHz) and E = 45 dBµV/m (230-1,000 MHz).
condition: Vehicle-to-antenna spacing 3 m

text: Appendix 6: ESA broadband reference limits for a 120 kHz bandwidth shall be E = 62 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m (30-75 MHz), E = 52 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m (75-400 MHz) and E = 63 dBµV/m (400-1,000 MHz).

Appendix 7: ESA narrowband reference limits for a 120 kHz bandwidth shall be E = 52 - 25.13 log (F/30) dBµV/m (30-75 MHz), E = 42 + 15.13 log (F/75) dBµV/m (75-400 MHz) and E = 53 dBµV/m (400-1,000 MHz).
Measurement ports of asymmetric artificial networks (AANs) used for signal/control port lines and/or wired network port lines in charging mode tests shall be terminated with 50 Ω loads.
condition: REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: If shielded signal/control port lines are used, shielded AANs defined in CISPR 32:2015 Annex G, Figures G.10 and G.11 should be used; the AANs of paragraphs 5.1. to 5.4. are used for unshielded signal/control port lines and/or wired network port lines.
condition: If shielded signal/control port lines are used

text: The asymmetric artificial network (AAN) for signal/control ports with symmetric lines, connected between the vehicle and the charging station or any auxiliary equipment (AE) used to simulate communication, shall be as defined in CISPR 16-1-2 Annex E Clause E.2 (T network circuit), with a common mode impedance of 150 Ω.
condition: signal/control port with symmetric lines in REESS charging mode
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The value of longitudinal conversion loss (LCL) set by the impedance Zcat of the AAN for symmetric lines should be predetermined by measurements or be defined by the manufacturer of the charging station/charging harness.
condition: signal/control port with symmetric lines

text: The selected value for LCL and its origin shall be stated in the test report.
condition: signal/control port with symmetric lines

text: An AAN is not required for CAN communication if an original charging station can be used for the test.
condition: if an original charging station can be used for the test

text: No AAN should be used for CAN communication if the CAN communication is emulated and the presence of the AAN prevents proper CAN communication.
condition: if CAN communication is emulated and the AAN prevents proper CAN communication

text: For a wired network port with PLC on power lines, an AAN and/or AMN/DC-charging-AN might not be required for PLC communication if an original charging station can be used for the test.
condition: if an original charging station can be used for the test

text: If the presence of the AMN/DC-charging-AN prevents proper PLC communication with the original charging station, or if the PLC communication needs to be simulated by auxiliary equipment (e.g. a PLC modem), an AAN shall be added between the AE (e.g. the PLC modem) and the AMN/DC-charging-AN output (vehicle side), as shown in Figure 9.
condition: if the AMN/DC-charging-AN prevents proper PLC communication or PLC communication is simulated by AE

text: For emission tests, an attenuator consisting of two resistors in combination with the input/output impedance of the PLC modem shall be located between the powerline and the PLC modem at the AE side, with resistor values depending on the design impedance of the PLC modems and the allowed attenuation for the PLC system.
condition: emission tests with PLC on power lines simulated by AE

text: In the AAN for PLC on AC or DC power lines, resistors R1 of 2,5 kΩ apply for 40 dB attenuation and 100 Ω PLC design impedance; the resistor values depend on the allowed attenuation and the design impedance of the PLC modem.
condition: PLC on AC or DC power lines

text: For a signal/control port with PLC (technology) on control pilot, a special AAN shall be used as defined in Figure 10, providing a common mode impedance of 150 Ω ± 20 Ω (150 kHz to 30 MHz) on the control pilot line (assuming a modem design impedance of 100 Ω).
condition: signal/control port with PLC on control pilot

text: The values of inductance and capacitance in the networks added for PLC on control pilot shown in Figure 10 shall not induce any malfunction of communication between vehicle and AE or charging station; these values may need to be adapted to ensure proper communication.
condition: signal/control port with PLC on control pilot

text: No AAN should be used if PLC communication on control pilot is emulated and the presence of the AAN prevents proper PLC communication.
condition: if PLC communication is emulated and the AAN prevents proper PLC communication

text: The resistor values of the AAN for PLC on control pilot (e.g. R1 39 Ω, R2 270 Ω) depend on the design impedance of the PLC modem connected at AE side; the values given in the schematic are valid for a design impedance of 100 Ω.
condition: signal/control port with PLC on control pilot

text: For a signal/control port with control pilot, a special AAN shall be used as defined in Figure 11, providing a common mode impedance of 150 Ω ± 20 Ω (150 kHz to 30 MHz) on the control pilot line (between A and B/D).
condition: signal/control port with control pilot

text: The values of inductance and capacitance in the networks on control pilot shown in Figure 11 shall not induce any malfunction of communication between vehicle and charging station; these values may need to be adapted to ensure proper communication.
condition: signal/control port with control pilot

text: No AAN should be used if control pilot communication is emulated and the presence of the AAN prevents proper control pilot communication.
condition: if control pilot communication is emulated and the AAN prevents proper communication

text: The approval mark affixed to a vehicle or ESA shall be arranged as in Model A or Model B of Annex 1, with dimension a = 6 mm min.

The test method of Annex 4 for radiated broadband electromagnetic emissions shall only be applied to vehicles, in both configurations: other than "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" and "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid".
If not otherwise stated in Annex 4, the vehicle radiated broadband emission test shall be performed according to CISPR 12.
For two-wheeled vehicles, a non-conductive insulating support with a thickness of 5 – 20 mm shall be used between stand and ground plane during the broadband emission test.
condition: two-wheeled vehicles

text: In configuration other than REESS charging mode, the engine shall be in operation according to CISPR 12 during the broadband emission test.
condition: configuration other than REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: For vehicles with an electric propulsion motor or hybrid propulsion system, transmission shafts, belts or chains may be disconnected to achieve the same operation condition for the propulsion, if operation according to CISPR 12 is not appropriate (e.g. buses, trucks, two- and three-wheel vehicles).
condition: electric or hybrid propulsion where CISPR 12 operation is not appropriate

text: If the operating mode defined in CISPR 12 (i.e. 40 km/h) does not activate all traction motors or auxiliary battery charging engines, an alternative steady state operating mode shall be agreed between the Technical Service and vehicle manufacturer.
condition: if the CISPR 12 operating mode does not activate all traction motors or auxiliary battery charging engines

text: All equipment capable of generating broadband emissions which can be switched on permanently by the driver or passenger (e.g. wiper motors or fans) should be in operation in maximum load during the broadband emission test; the horn and electric window motors are excluded.
condition: configuration other than REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: In configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid", the vehicle shall be tested in the charging mode configuration (if available on vehicle) as defined in the flowchart of Figure 1 of Annex 4.
condition: REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: In case of multiple batteries, the average state of charge shall be considered during the broadband emission test in charging mode.
condition: REESS charging mode with multiple batteries

text: In charging mode, the vehicle shall be immobilized and the engine(s) (ICE and/or electrical engine) shall be OFF and in charging mode.
condition: REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: In charging mode, all other equipment which can be switched ON by the driver or passengers shall be OFF.
condition: REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The test set-up for connection of the vehicle in REESS charging mode shall be as shown in Figures 3a to 3h of Appendix 1 to Annex 4, depending on AC or DC charging mode, charging plug location and charging with or without communication.
condition: REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For charging mode 1 or 2, the power mains socket(s) shall be placed on the ground plane (ALSE) or floor (OTS).
condition: charging mode 1 or mode 2 (AC without communication)
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For charging mode 1 or 2, the length of the harness between the power mains socket and the AMN(s) shall be kept as short as possible, but not necessarily aligned with the charging harness.
condition: charging mode 1 or mode 2 (AC without communication)
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For charging mode 1 or 2, the harness between the power mains socket and the AMN(s) shall be placed as close as possible to the ground plane (ALSE) or floor (OTS).
condition: charging mode 1 or mode 2 (AC without communication)
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For charging mode 1 or 2, power mains shall be applied to the vehicle through 50 µH/50 Ω artificial networks (AMN(s)) as defined in Appendix 8, paragraph 4.
condition: charging mode 1 or mode 2 (AC without communication)
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The AMN(s) shall be mounted directly on the ground plane (ALSE) or floor (OTS).
condition: charging mode 1 or mode 2
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The case of the AMN(s) shall be bonded to the ground plane (ALSE) or connected to the protective earth (OTS, e.g. an earth rod).
condition: charging mode 1 or mode 2
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The measuring port of each AMN shall be terminated with a 50 Ω load.
condition: charging mode 1 or mode 2
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The power charging harness shall be placed in a straight line between the AMN(s) and the vehicle charging plug and shall be routed perpendicularly to the vehicle longitudinal axis.
condition: charging mode 1 or mode 2
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The projected power charging harness length from the side of the AMN(s) to the side of the vehicle shall be 0,8 (+0,2 / -0) m.
condition: charging mode 1 or mode 2
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For a longer power charging cable, the extraneous length shall be "Z-folded" symmetrically with no contact or overlap between windings and a width of the Z-folded cable between 500 mm and 1 000 mm.
condition: charging mode 1 or mode 2, cable longer than projected length
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: If Z-folding is impractical because of cable bulk or stiffness or because testing is done at a user's installation, the disposition of the excess cable length shall be precisely noted in the test report.
condition: if Z-folding is impractical
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The charging harness at the vehicle side shall hang vertically at a distance of 100 (+200 / -0) mm from the vehicle body.
condition: charging mode 1 or mode 2
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The whole charging harness shall be placed on a non-conductive, low relative permittivity material (εr ≤ 1,4), at (100 ± 25) mm above the ground plane (ALSE) or floor (OTS).
condition: charging mode 1 or mode 2
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For charging mode 3 or 4, the charging station may be placed either in or outside the test site, and may be replaced by a supply from the AC power mains network if the local/private communication between vehicle and charging station can be simulated.
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4 (with communication)
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For charging mode 3 or 4, power mains and communication or signal lines socket(s) shall be placed in the test site on the ground plane (ALSE) or floor (OTS).
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The length of the harness between the power mains / local/private communication socket and the AMN(s) / DC-charging-AN(s) / AAN(s) shall be kept as short as possible, but not necessarily aligned with the charging harness.
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The harness between the power mains / local/private communication socket and the AMN(s) / DC-charging-AN(s) / AAN(s) shall be placed as close as possible to the ground plane (ALSE) or floor (OTS).
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: If the charging station is placed inside the test site, the harness between the charging station and the power mains / local/private communication socket shall hang vertically down to the ground plane (ALSE) or floor (OTS) at charging station side.
condition: charging station placed inside the test site
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: If the charging station is placed inside the test site, the extraneous length of the harness shall be placed as close as possible to the ground plane (ALSE) or floor (OTS) and "Z-folded" if necessary; if impractical, the disposition of the excess cable shall be precisely noted in the test report.
condition: charging station placed inside the test site
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The charging station should be placed outside of the 3 dB beamwidth of the receiving antenna; if not technically feasible, it can be placed behind a panel of absorbers but not between the antenna and the vehicle.
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For charging mode 3 or 4, AC power mains shall be applied to the vehicle through 50 µH/50 Ω AMN(s) as defined in Appendix 8, paragraph 4.
condition: charging mode 3 (AC with communication)
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For charging mode 4, DC power mains shall be applied to the vehicle through 5 µH/50 Ω DC-charging-AN(s) as defined in Appendix 8, paragraph 3.
condition: charging mode 4 (DC with communication)
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The AMN(s) / DC-charging-AN(s) shall be mounted directly on the ground plane (ALSE) or floor (OTS).
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The cases of the AMN(s) / DC-charging-AN(s) shall be bonded to the ground plane (ALSE) or connected to the protective earth (OTS, e.g. an earth rod).
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The measuring port of each AMN / DC-charging-AN shall be terminated with a 50 Ω load.
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: Local/private communication lines connected to signal/control ports and lines connected to wired network ports shall be applied to the vehicle through AAN(s) as defined in Appendix 8, paragraph 5 (5.1 symmetric lines; 5.2 PLC on power lines; 5.3 PLC on control pilot; 5.4 control pilot).
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4

text: The AAN(s) shall be mounted directly on the ground plane.
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4

text: The case of the AAN(s) shall be bonded to the ground plane (ALSE) or connected to the protective earth (OTS, e.g. an earth rod).
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4

text: The measuring port of each AAN shall be terminated with a 50 Ω load.
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4

text: If a charging station is used, AAN(s) are not required for the signal/control ports and/or the wired network ports.
condition: if a charging station is used

text: The local/private communication lines between the vehicle and the charging station shall be connected to the auxiliary equipment on the charging station side to work as designed.
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4

text: If communication is emulated and the presence of the AAN prevents proper communication, no AAN should be used.
condition: if communication is emulated and the AAN prevents proper communication

text: The power charging / local/private communication harness shall be laid out in a straight line between the AMN(s) / DC-charging-AN(s) / AAN(s) and the vehicle charging socket and shall be routed perpendicularly to the vehicle's longitudinal axis.
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The projected power charging / communication harness length from the side of the AMN(s) to the side of the vehicle shall be 0,8 (+0,2 / -0) m.
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For a longer power charging / communication cable, the extraneous length shall be "Z-folded" symmetrically with no contact or overlap between windings and a width of the Z-folded cable between 500 mm and 1 000 mm.
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4, cable longer than projected length
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: If Z-folding is impractical because of cable bulk or stiffness or because testing is done at a user's installation, the disposition of the excess cable length shall be precisely noted in the test report.
condition: if Z-folding is impractical
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The power charging / local/private communication harness at vehicle side shall hang vertically at a distance of 100 (+200 / -0) mm from the vehicle body.
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The whole power charging / communication harness shall be placed on a non-conductive, low relative permittivity material (εr ≤ 1,4), at (100 ± 25) mm above the ground plane (ALSE) or floor (OTS).
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For vehicles of category L, as an alternative to CISPR 12, the test surface may be any location that fulfils the conditions shown in Figure 2 of the Appendix to Annex 4, in which case the measuring equipment shall lie outside the part shown in Figure 1 of Appendix 1 to Annex 4.
condition: if the alternative test surface is used

text: Absorber lined shielded enclosures (ALSE) and outdoor test sites (OTS) may be used as measuring location for the vehicle broadband emission test.
The vehicle broadband emission limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or an outdoor test site (OTS).

Vehicle broadband emission measurements can be performed with either quasi-peak or peak detectors; the limits of paragraphs 6.2. and 7.2. are for quasi-peak detectors, and if peak detectors are used a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.
condition: if peak detectors are used

text: Vehicle broadband emission measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver using the parameters defined in Table 1 and Table 2; spectrum analysers and FFT-based instruments that meet the requirements of CISPR 16-1-1 may be used for conformity measurements.

FFT-based measuring instruments shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time, with a minimum measurement time of 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode) of the FFT instrument.
condition: if FFT-based instruments are used

text: For vehicle broadband emission measurements with a spectrum analyser and peak detector in the 30 to 1,000 MHz range, the RBW at -3 dB shall be 100/120 kHz and the minimum scan time 100 ms/MHz.
condition: spectrum analyser, peak detector

text: For vehicle broadband emission measurements with a spectrum analyser and quasi-peak detector in the 30 to 1,000 MHz range, the RBW at -6 dB shall be 120 kHz and the minimum scan time 20 s/MHz.
condition: spectrum analyser, quasi-peak detector

text: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video bandwidth shall be at least three times the resolution bandwidth (RBW).
condition: spectrum analyser used for peak measurements

text: For vehicle broadband emission measurements with a scanning receiver and peak detector in the 30 to 1,000 MHz range, the BW at -6 dB shall be 120 kHz, the maximum step size 60 kHz and the minimum dwell time 5 ms; for purely broadband disturbances the maximum frequency step size may be increased up to a value not greater than the bandwidth value.
condition: scanning receiver, peak detector

text: For vehicle broadband emission measurements with a scanning receiver and quasi-peak detector in the 30 to 1,000 MHz range, the BW at -6 dB shall be 120 kHz, the maximum step size 60 kHz and the minimum dwell time 1 s; for purely broadband disturbances the maximum frequency step size may be increased up to a value not greater than the bandwidth value.
condition: scanning receiver, quasi-peak detector

text: The Technical Service shall perform the vehicle broadband emission test at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz.

If the manufacturer provides measurement data for the whole frequency band from a test laboratory accredited to the applicable parts of ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type Approval Authority, the Technical Service may divide the frequency range into the 14 frequency bands 30-34, 34-45, 45-60, 60-80, 80-100, 100-130, 130-170, 170-225, 225-300, 300-400, 400-525, 525-700, 700-850 and 850-1,000 MHz and perform tests at the 14 frequencies giving the highest emission levels within each band to confirm that the vehicle meets the requirements of Annex 4.
condition: if the manufacturer provides measurement data from an ISO 17025 accredited and recognized laboratory

text: For configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid", if the manufacturer provides measurement data for the whole frequency band from an ISO 17025 accredited and recognized laboratory for all available charging mode configurations defined in 2.2, the Technical Service may test only one of the available charging mode configurations and divide the frequency range into the 14 frequency bands, testing at the 14 frequencies giving the highest emission levels within each band.
condition: REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid; manufacturer data for all charging modes provided
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the vehicle broadband emission test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the vehicle and not to background radiation.
condition: if the limit is exceeded during the test

text: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal and vertical polarization and antenna location on the left and right-hand sides of the vehicle) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.

Vehicle broadband emission measurements shall be made on the left and right sides of the vehicle, with the horizontal distance measured from the reference point of the antenna to the nearest part of the vehicle body.
The same antenna positions shall be used for both horizontal and vertical polarization measurements.
The number of antenna positions and the position of the antenna with respect to the vehicle shall be documented in the test report.

If the length of the vehicle is smaller than the 3 dB beamwidth of the antenna (N=1), only one antenna position is necessary and the antenna shall be aligned with the middle of the total vehicle length.
condition: vehicle length smaller than the 3 dB antenna beamwidth

text: If the length of the vehicle is greater than the 3 dB beamwidth of the antenna (N>1), multiple antenna positions shall be used to cover the total length of the vehicle; the number of antenna positions N shall meet the condition defined by measurement distance D (3 m or 10 m), 3 dB antenna beamwidth angle 2β and total vehicle length L (including tires, bumpers and lights).
condition: vehicle length greater than the 3 dB antenna beamwidth

text: Where multiple antenna positions are used, the antenna positions shall be symmetric in regard to the vehicle perpendicular axis.
The narrowband emission test method of Annex 5 shall only be applied to vehicles and concerns only the configuration of the vehicle other than "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid".
condition: configuration other than REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: If not otherwise stated in Annex 5, the vehicle narrowband emission test shall be performed according to CISPR 12.
For vehicles of category L, the narrowband emission measurement location may be chosen according to Annex 4, paragraphs 3.1. and 3.2.
During the vehicle narrowband emission test, the ignition switch shall be switched on and the engine shall not be operating.
For two-wheeled vehicles, a non-conductive insulating support with a thickness of 5 – 20 mm shall be used between stand and ground plane during the narrowband emission test.
condition: two-wheeled vehicles

text: During the narrowband emission test the vehicle's electronic systems shall all be in normal operating mode with the vehicle stationary.

All equipment which can be switched on permanently by the driver or passenger with internal oscillators > 9 kHz or repetitive signals should be in normal operation during the narrowband emission test.
Absorber lined shielded enclosures (ALSE) and outdoor test sites (OTS) may be used for the vehicle narrowband emission test.
The vehicle narrowband emission limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an ALSE or an OTS.
Vehicle narrowband emission measurements shall be performed with an average detector.

Vehicle narrowband emission measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver using the parameters defined in Table 1 and Table 2; spectrum analysers and FFT-based instruments that meet the requirements of CISPR 16-1-1 may be used for conformity measurements.

FFT-based measuring instruments shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time, with a minimum measurement time of 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode) of the FFT instrument.
condition: if FFT-based instruments are used

text: For vehicle narrowband emission measurements with a spectrum analyser and average detector in the 30 to 1,000 MHz range, the RBW at -3 dB shall be 100/120 kHz and the minimum scan time 100 ms/MHz.
condition: spectrum analyser

text: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video bandwidth shall be at least three times the resolution bandwidth (RBW).
condition: spectrum analyser used for peak measurements

text: For vehicle narrowband emission measurements with a scanning receiver and average detector in the 30 to 1,000 MHz range, the BW at -6 dB shall be 120 kHz, the maximum step size 60 kHz and the minimum dwell time 5 ms.
condition: scanning receiver

text: The Technical Service shall perform the vehicle narrowband emission test at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz.

If the manufacturer provides measurement data for the whole frequency band from a test laboratory accredited to the applicable parts of ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type Approval Authority, the Technical Service may divide the frequency range into the 14 frequency bands 30-34, 34-45, 45-60, 60-80, 80-100, 100-130, 130-170, 170-225, 225-300, 300-400, 400-525, 525-700, 700-850 and 850-1,000 MHz and perform tests at the 14 frequencies giving the highest emission levels within each band to confirm that the vehicle meets the requirements of Annex 5.
condition: if the manufacturer provides measurement data from an ISO 17025 accredited and recognized laboratory

text: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the vehicle narrowband emission test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the vehicle and not to background radiation including broadband radiation from any ESA.
condition: if the limit is exceeded during the test

text: The maximum of the narrowband readings relative to the limit (horizontal and vertical polarization and antenna location on the left and right-hand sides of the vehicle) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.

Vehicle narrowband emission measurements shall be made on the left and right sides of the vehicle, with the horizontal distance measured from the reference point of the antenna to the nearest part of the vehicle body.
The same antenna positions shall be used for both horizontal and vertical polarization narrowband measurements.
The number of antenna positions and the position of the antenna with respect to the vehicle shall be documented in the narrowband emission test report.

If the length of the vehicle is smaller than the 3 dB beamwidth of the antenna (N=1), only one antenna position is necessary and the antenna shall be aligned with the middle of the total vehicle length.
condition: vehicle length smaller than the 3 dB antenna beamwidth

text: If the length of the vehicle is greater than the 3 dB beamwidth of the antenna (N>1), multiple antenna positions shall be used to cover the total length of the vehicle; the number of antenna positions N shall meet the condition defined by measurement distance D (3 m or 10 m), 3 dB antenna beamwidth angle 2β and total vehicle length L (including tires, bumpers and lights).
condition: vehicle length greater than the 3 dB antenna beamwidth

text: Where multiple antenna positions are used for narrowband measurements, the antenna positions shall be symmetric in regard to the vehicle perpendicular axis.

The test method for immunity of vehicles to electromagnetic radiation described in Annex 6 shall only be applied to vehicles, in both configurations: other than "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" and "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid".
In the vehicle immunity test the vehicle shall be subject to electromagnetic fields as described in Annex 6.
The vehicle shall be monitored during the immunity tests.

If not otherwise stated in Annex 6, the vehicle immunity test shall be performed according to ISO 11451-2 in an ALSE with front irradiation for vehicles not considered as "large vehicles" (rear irradiation as specified in paragraph 5.1.3.).
condition: regular test method; vehicle not longer than 12 m, not wider than 2.60 m and not higher than 4.00 m

text: For "large vehicles" (longer than 12 m and/or wider than 2.60 m and/or higher than 4.00 m), the vehicle immunity test shall be performed according to ISO 11451-2 in an ALSE with front irradiation and with additional antenna positions.
condition: regular test method; large vehicle

text: Additional antenna position(s) for large vehicles shall be chosen by the manufacturer in conjunction with the Type-Approval Authority after considering the distribution of electronic systems with immunity related functions and the layout of any wiring harness.
condition: large vehicle tested in ALSE

text: Vehicle immunity tests in the ALSE shall be performed with the levels defined in paragraph 6.4.2.1. of this Regulation.
condition: regular test method

text: For REESS charging mode, only the electronic systems and wiring harnesses required for charging mode shall be considered for antenna positions.
condition: vehicle in REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid; regular test method
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The vehicle immunity test may alternatively be performed in an outdoor test site (OTS) for all vehicles (including large vehicles), provided that the test facility complies with (national) legal requirements regarding the emission of electromagnetic fields.
condition: alternative test method in OTS

text: When performed in an OTS, the vehicle immunity test shall be performed according to ISO 11451-2 with front irradiation for vehicles not considered as "large vehicles" (rear irradiation as specified in paragraph 5.1.3.).
condition: alternative test method in OTS; vehicle not a large vehicle

text: When performed in an OTS, the vehicle immunity test for "large vehicles" shall be performed according to ISO 11451-2 with front irradiation and with additional antenna positions, chosen by the manufacturer in conjunction with the Type Approval Authority after considering the distribution of electronic systems with immunity related functions and the layout of any wiring harness.
condition: alternative test method in OTS; large vehicle

text: Vehicle immunity tests in the OTS shall be performed with the levels defined in paragraph 6.4.2.1. of this Regulation.
condition: alternative test method in OTS

text: For REESS charging mode tested in an OTS, only the electronic systems and wiring harnesses required for charging mode shall be considered for antenna positions.
condition: vehicle in REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid; alternative test method in OTS
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For large vehicles, the manufacturer in conjunction with the Type Approval Authority may choose harness excitation methods (BCI) according to ISO 11451-4 in the frequency range 20 to 2,000 MHz and immunity to external sources according to ISO 11451-2 in ALSE or OTS in the frequency range 2,000 to 6,000 MHz with additional antenna position(s), chosen by the manufacturer in conjunction with the Type Approval Authority after considering the distribution of electronic systems with immunity related functions and the layout of any wiring harness; tests shall be performed with levels defined in paragraph 6.4.2.1.
condition: large vehicle; alternative method BCI plus ISO 11451-2 above 2,000 MHz chosen

text: For large vehicles, the manufacturer in conjunction with the Type Approval Authority may choose harness excitation methods (BCI) according to ISO 11451-4 in the frequency range 20 to 2,000 MHz and ESA immunity to external sources according to Annex 9 in the frequency range 2,000 to 6,000 MHz for all ESA involved in immunity related functions; these ESA shall be chosen by the manufacturer in conjunction with the Type Approval Authority, the vehicle test shall be performed with levels defined in paragraph 6.4.2.1. and the ESA tests with levels defined in paragraph 6.8.2.1.
condition: large vehicle; alternative method BCI plus ESA tests above 2,000 MHz chosen

text: For large vehicles, the manufacturer in conjunction with the Type Approval Authority may choose immunity to external sources according to ISO 11451-2 in ALSE or OTS in the frequency range 20 to 6,000 MHz with front irradiation and ESA immunity to external sources according to Annex 9 in the frequency range 20 to 6,000 MHz for ESA with immunity related functions outside the antenna beamwidth; the concerned ESA shall be chosen by the manufacturer in conjunction with the Type-Approval Authority, the vehicle test shall be performed with levels defined in paragraph 6.4.2.1. and the ESA tests with levels defined in paragraph 6.8.2.1.
condition: large vehicle; alternative method front irradiation plus ESA tests for ESA out of antenna beamwidth chosen

text: The alternative method using ESA immunity to external sources according to Annex 9 does not require E-marking of the concerned ESA.
condition: alternative method using ESA tests according to Annex 9 for large vehicles

text: When the alternative method using ESA immunity tests according to Annex 9 is used, the ESA test report shall be prepared or approved by a laboratory accredited to ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type Approval Authority responsible for carrying out the tests, and shall be provided along with the information document shown in Annex 2B.
condition: alternative method using ESA tests according to Annex 9 for large vehicles

text: The same test method (vehicle type approval in combination with ESA test report for Annex 9) shall be applied during the Conformity of Production test, or any applicable test method according to Annex 6.
condition: large vehicle approved using the alternative method with ESA test report according to Annex 9

text: The applicability of the vehicle immunity test methods shall be as shown in Figure 1 of Annex 6.
For two-wheeled vehicles tested for immunity to electromagnetic radiation, a non-conductive insulating support with a thickness of 5 – 20 mm shall be used between stand and ground plane.
condition: for two-wheeled vehicles

text: During the vehicle immunity test in configuration other than REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid, the vehicle shall be in an unladen condition except for necessary test equipment.
condition: vehicle in configuration other than REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: During the vehicle immunity test, the engine shall normally turn the driving wheels at a steady speed of 50 km/h if there is no technical reason due to the vehicle to define a different condition.
condition: vehicle in configuration other than REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: For vehicles of categories L1 and L2 the steady speed of the driving wheels during the vehicle immunity test shall normally be 25 km/h.
condition: vehicle in configuration other than REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: During the vehicle immunity test the vehicle shall be on an appropriately loaded dynamometer or alternatively supported on insulated axle stands with minimum ground clearance if no dynamometer is available.
condition: vehicle in configuration other than REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: Where appropriate, transmission shafts, belts or chains may be disconnected during the vehicle immunity test (e.g. trucks, two- and three-wheel vehicles).
condition: where appropriate

text: Other vehicle systems, which can affect immunity related functions, shall be tested in a way to be agreed between manufacturer and Technical Service.
condition: vehicle in configuration other than REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: In 50 km/h mode, the vehicle speed shall be 50 km/h (respectively 25 km/h for L1, L2 vehicles) ±20 per cent with the vehicle driving the rollers; a speed variation greater than ±10 per cent of the nominal speed is a failure.
condition: 50 km/h mode

text: In 50 km/h mode, if the vehicle is equipped with a cruise control system, it shall be used to maintain the required constant vehicle speed and maintained without any deactivation.
condition: if the vehicle is equipped with a cruise control system

text: In 50 km/h mode, for vehicles with automatic gearbox, a change of gear ratio inducing a speed variation greater than ±10 per cent of the nominal speed is a failure.
condition: in case of automatic gearbox

text: In 50 km/h mode, dipped beams shall be ON (manual mode); lighting OFF (front light and rear light) is a failure.
condition: 50 km/h mode

text: In 50 km/h mode, specific warning (e.g. rotating/flashing light, signaling bar, siren) shall be ON; specific warning OFF is a failure.
condition: 50 km/h mode; if specific warning fitted

text: In 50 km/h mode, the cluster shall operate in normal mode; an unexpected warning or an inconsistent variation of the odometer is a failure.
condition: 50 km/h mode

text: In 50 km/h mode, for the rear view system, an unexpected movement of rear view mirror or loss or freezing of the display (CMS) is a failure.
condition: 50 km/h mode

text: In 50 km/h mode, the front wiper shall be ON (manual mode) at maximum speed; complete stop of front wiper is a failure.
condition: 50 km/h mode

text: In 50 km/h mode, the direction indicator on driver's side shall be ON; a frequency change (lower than 0.75 Hz or greater than 2.25 Hz) is a failure.
condition: 50 km/h mode

text: In 50 km/h mode, with the direction indicator on driver's side ON, a duty cycle change (lower than 25 per cent or greater than 75 per cent) is a failure.
condition: 50 km/h mode

text: In 50 km/h mode, adjustable suspension shall be in normal position; an unexpected significant variation is a failure.
condition: 50 km/h mode; if adjustable suspension fitted

text: In 50 km/h mode, driver's seat and steering wheel shall be in medium position; an unexpected variation greater than 10 per cent of total range is a failure.
condition: 50 km/h mode

text: In 50 km/h mode, the alarm shall be unset; unexpected activation of alarm is a failure.
condition: 50 km/h mode

text: In 50 km/h mode, the horn shall be OFF; unexpected activation of horn is a failure.
condition: 50 km/h mode

text: In 50 km/h mode, airbag and safety restraint systems shall be operational with inhibited passenger airbag if this function exists; unexpected activation is a failure.
condition: 50 km/h mode

text: In 50 km/h mode, automatic doors shall be closed; unexpected opening is a failure.
condition: 50 km/h mode; if automatic doors fitted

text: In 50 km/h mode, the adjustable endurance brake lever shall be in normal position; unexpected activation is a failure.
condition: 50 km/h mode; if endurance brake fitted

text: In 50 km/h mode, the brake pedal shall not be depressed; unexpected activation of brake and unexpected activation of stop lights is a failure.
condition: 50 km/h mode

text: In 50 km/h mode, the ADS shall be operational; the ADS not remaining in a failure safe mode or expected failure operational mode is a failure.
condition: 50 km/h mode; if vehicle equipped with ADS

text: In brake mode, the vehicle shall be in a state that allows the braking system to operate normally, parking brake released, vehicle speed 0 km/h, with the brake pedal depressed to activate the brake function and the stop lights without any dynamic cycle; stop lights inactivated during mode is a failure.
condition: brake mode

text: In brake mode, brake warning light ON with loss of brake function is a failure.
condition: brake mode

text: In brake mode, the daytime running light (DRL) shall be ON; DRL inactivated during mode is a failure.
condition: brake mode; if DRL fitted

text: In brake mode, the ADS shall be operational; the ADS not remaining in a failure safe mode or expected failure operational mode is a failure.
condition: brake mode; if vehicle equipped with ADS

text: For AECS, a manual emergency call shall be triggered according to the vehicle manufacturer's instructions both before and after conducting the 50 km/h or brake mode test; an emergency call not established is a failure.
condition: if vehicle equipped with AECS

text: For AECS, once the MSD has been received and the emergency call is established, voice communication shall be evaluated; the voice originating inside the vehicle not heard clearly by the remote listener with satisfactory intelligibility, or the speech of the remote speaker not heard clearly in the vehicle with satisfactory intelligibility, is a failure.
condition: only if voice communications are available in the AECS system

text: For AECS, after the evaluation of the voice call the emergency call shall be terminated and subsequently the transmitted Minimum Set of Data (MSD) shall be evaluated.
condition: if vehicle equipped with AECS

text: For AECS MSD evaluation, vehicle location data not transmitted, or a position error greater than 150 m, is a failure.
condition: if vehicle equipped with AECS

text: For AECS MSD evaluation, time stamp not transmitted, or a time error greater than 60 seconds, is a failure.
condition: if vehicle equipped with AECS

text: For AECS MSD evaluation, vehicle identification number not transmitted correctly is a failure.
condition: if vehicle equipped with AECS

text: During the 50 km/h or brake test mode, the AECS warning signal device (tell-tale) and all other displays used for indicating AECS faults shall be monitored; a cellular network or satellite navigation signals are not required during these tests.
condition: if vehicle equipped with AECS

text: During the immunity test, failure indication of the AECS warning signal device or other vehicle displays is a failure of the emergency calling system.
condition: if vehicle equipped with AECS

text: Upon completion of the immunity test, a diagnostic trouble code related to emergency calling systems failure indication stored in the device memory is a failure.
condition: if vehicle equipped with AECS

text: The vehicle shall be tested in an operating state where the AVAS function/sound is active (if applicable); loss of AVAS function (loss of sound or system error indicator) is a failure.
condition: if vehicle equipped with AVAS

text: The AVAS test may be incorporated into Brake or 50 km/h mode if the AVAS system is active in these modes; if the AVAS system is not operational during these two modes, the operating conditions (e.g. vehicle speed) shall be agreed between the Technical Service and the Vehicle Manufacturer.
condition: if vehicle equipped with AVAS

text: During the vehicle immunity test, all equipment which can be switched on permanently by the driver or passenger should be in normal operation.
condition: vehicle in configuration other than REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: During the vehicle immunity test, all other systems which affect the driver's control of the vehicle shall be (on) as in normal operation of the vehicle.
condition: vehicle in configuration other than REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: If the vehicle is equipped with an ADS, the immunity test shall demonstrate the vehicle stays in a failure safe mode or expected failure operational mode during the test in 50 km/h mode or Brake mode.
condition: if the vehicle is equipped with an ADS

text: If it is not possible to activate the ADS due to another function (e.g. turn lamp, wiper), these function(s) may be turned off, and additional test run(s) may be necessary to cover the untested function(s).
condition: if it is not possible to activate the ADS due to another function

text: Lateral and longitudinal vehicle motion control and braking may be deactivated during the ADS immunity test if necessary to ensure a safe test environment.
condition: if necessary to ensure a safe test environment

text: If the vehicle is equipped with an AECS according to UN Regulation No. 144, it shall be tested over the air for the transmission of Minimum Set of Data (MSD) and voice call via a real Public Land Mobile Network (PLMN) or via a network simulator before and after 50 km/h or brake mode and using a private safety answering point (PSAP).
condition: if the vehicle is equipped with an AECS according to UN Regulation No. 144

text: In case of a voice call via a real PLMN, the emergency call number should be changed to a dedicated PSAP number in order to avoid false calls to the emergency services.
condition: in case of a voice call via a real PLMN

text: Only one specific cellular configuration, including one frequency band and one channel, within a single cellular technology (e.g. 2G, 3G, 4G, 5G) shall be tested for the AECS.
condition: if the vehicle is equipped with an AECS

text: Vehicle manufacturer and Technical Service shall review the AECS warning signal strategy as to whether it will detect AECS system faults even when there is no network coverage.
condition: if the vehicle is equipped with an AECS

text: If it is not possible to distinguish between lack of network coverage and an AECS system fault, alternative arrangements shall be made to enable this.
condition: if it is not possible to distinguish between lack of network coverage and a system fault

text: If vehicle electrical/electronic systems which form an integral part of the immunity related functions will not operate under the conditions described in paragraph 2.1., the manufacturer may provide a report or additional evidence to the Technical Service that the vehicle electrical/electronic system meets the requirements of this Regulation; such evidence shall be retained in the type approval documentation.
condition: if systems forming part of immunity related functions will not operate under the conditions of paragraph 2.1

text: Only non-perturbing equipment shall be used while monitoring the vehicle during the immunity test.
condition: vehicle in configuration other than REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: The vehicle exterior and the passenger compartment shall be monitored to determine whether the requirements of Annex 6 are met (e.g. by using video camera(s), a microphone, etc.).
condition: vehicle in configuration other than REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: During the vehicle immunity test in configuration REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid, the vehicle shall be in an unladen condition except for necessary test equipment.
condition: vehicle in configuration REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: During the vehicle immunity test in charging mode, the vehicle shall be immobilized, the engine(s) (ICE and/or electrical engine) shall be OFF and in charging mode.
condition: vehicle in configuration REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: The vehicle shall be tested in the charging mode configuration (if available on vehicle) as defined in the flowchart of Figure 2 of Annex 6.
condition: if the charging mode configuration is available on the vehicle
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: In REESS charging mode, other vehicle systems which can affect immunity related functions shall be tested in a way to be agreed between manufacturer and Technical Service.
condition: vehicle in configuration REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: During the vehicle immunity test in REESS charging mode, the REESS shall be in charging mode.
condition: vehicle in configuration REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: The REESS state of charge (SOC) shall be kept between 20 per cent and 80 per cent of the maximum SOC during the whole frequency range measurement (this may lead to split the measurement in different sub-bands with the need to discharge the vehicle's traction battery before starting the next sub-bands).
condition: vehicle in configuration REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: In case of multiple batteries the average state of charge shall be considered.
condition: in case of multiple batteries

text: For AC charging, if the current consumption can be adjusted, the current shall be set to at least 20 per cent of its maximum rated charging/input current value.
condition: AC charging; if the current consumption can be adjusted
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For DC charging, if the current consumption can be adjusted, the current shall be set to at least 20 per cent of its maximum value or to a minimum of 16 A (if the 20 per cent of its maximum value cannot be achieved in the test facility) unless another value is agreed with the Type Approval Authorities.
condition: DC charging; if the current consumption can be adjusted
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: In REESS charging mode, the vehicle setting in motion is a failure of the immunity test.
condition: vehicle in configuration REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: In REESS charging mode, unexpected release of the parking brake is a failure of the immunity test.
condition: vehicle in configuration REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: In REESS charging mode, loss of Parking position for automatic transmission is a failure of the immunity test.
condition: vehicle in configuration REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid; automatic transmission

text: During the vehicle immunity test in charging mode, all other equipment which can be switched ON by the driver or passengers shall be OFF.
condition: vehicle in configuration REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: Only non-perturbing equipment shall be used while monitoring the vehicle in REESS charging mode during the immunity test.
condition: vehicle in configuration REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

condition: vehicle in configuration REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: The test set-up for the connection of the vehicle in configuration REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid shall be as shown in Figures 4a to 4h of Appendix 1 to Annex 6, depending on AC or DC power charging mode, location of charging plug and charging with or without communication.

applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

condition: if the charging station is placed inside the test site

applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For a vehicle in charging mode 3, AC power mains shall be applied to the vehicle through 50 µH/50 Ω AMN(s) as defined in Appendix 8, paragraph 4.
condition: AC charging with communication (mode 3)
