text: For a vehicle in charging mode 4, DC power mains shall be applied to the vehicle through 5 µH/50 Ω DC-charging-AN(s) as defined in Appendix 8, paragraph 3.
condition: DC charging with communication (mode 4)
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The AMN(s) / DC-charging-AN(s) shall be mounted directly on the ground plane (ALSE) or floor (OTS).
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4 (with communication)
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The cases of the AMN(s) / DC-charging-AN(s) shall be bonded to the ground plane (ALSE) or connected to the protective earth (OTS, e.g. an earth rod).
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4 (with communication)
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The measuring port of each AMN / DC-charging-AN shall be terminated with a 50 Ω load.
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4 (with communication)
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: Local/private communication lines connected to signal/control ports and lines connected to wired network ports shall be applied to the vehicle through AAN(s) as defined in Appendix 8, paragraph 5 (5.1 for signal/control port with symmetric lines; 5.2 for wired network port with PLC on power lines; 5.3 for signal/control port with PLC on control pilot; 5.4 for signal/control port with control pilot).
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4 (with communication)

text: The AAN(s) shall be mounted directly on the ground plane.
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4 (with communication)

text: The case of the AAN(s) shall be bonded to the ground plane (ALSE) or connected to the protective earth (OTS, e.g. an earth rod).
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4 (with communication)

text: The measuring port of each AAN shall be terminated with a 50 Ω load.
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4 (with communication)

text: If a charging station is used, AAN(s) are not required for the signal/control ports and/or for the wired network ports; the local/private communication lines between the vehicle and the charging station shall be connected to the auxiliary equipment on the charging station side to work as designed.
condition: if a charging station is used

text: If communication is emulated and if the presence of the AAN prevents proper communication, then no AAN should be used.
condition: if communication is emulated and the AAN prevents proper communication

text: For a vehicle in charging mode 3 or mode 4, the power charging local/private communication harness shall be laid out in a straight line between the AMN(s) / DC-charging-AN(s) / AAN(s) and the vehicle charging socket and shall be routed perpendicularly to the vehicle's longitudinal axis (see Figure 5e and Figure 5g).
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4 (with communication)
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The projected power charging / communication harness length from the side of the AMN(s) to the side of the vehicle shall be 0,8 (+0,2 / -0) m as shown in Figure 5f and Figure 5h.
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4 (with communication)
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For a longer power charging / communication cable, the extraneous length shall be Z-folded symmetrically, with no contact or overlap between windings, and the width of the Z-folded cable shall be between 500 mm and 1 000 mm.
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4; for a longer cable
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: If Z-folding is impractical because of cable bulk or stiffness, or because the testing is being done at a user's installation, the disposition of the excess cable length shall be precisely noted in the test report.
condition: if Z-folding is impractical
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The power charging local/private communication harness at vehicle side shall hang vertically at a distance of 100 (+200 / -0) mm from the vehicle body.
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4 (with communication)
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The whole power charging / communication harness shall be placed on a non-conductive, low relative permittivity (dielectric-constant) material (εr ≤ 1,4), at (100 ± 25) mm above the ground plane (ALSE) or floor (OTS).
condition: charging mode 3 or mode 4 (with communication)
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For the vehicle immunity test, the reference point is the point at which the field strength shall be established and shall be defined as specified in paragraphs 3.2 to 3.4 of Annex 6.
For the vehicle immunity test, the reference point for categories M, N, O, T, R and S vehicles shall be defined according to ISO 11451-2.

For category L vehicles, the reference point for the vehicle immunity test shall be at least 2 m horizontally from the antenna phase centre or at least 1 m vertically from the radiating elements of a transmission-line-system (TLS).
For category L vehicles, the reference point for the vehicle immunity test shall be on the vehicle's centre line (plane of longitudinal symmetry).

For category L vehicles, the reference point for the vehicle immunity test shall be at a height of 1.0 ± 0.05 m above the plane on which the vehicle rests, or 2.0 ± 0.05 m if the minimum height of the roof of any vehicle in the model range exceeds 3.0 m.

For three-wheeled or four-wheeled category L vehicles, the reference point for the vehicle immunity test shall be at 1.0 ± 0.2 m behind the vertical centreline of the vehicle's front wheel(s) (point C in Figure 1 of Appendix 1 to Annex 6).
condition: three-wheeled or four-wheeled vehicles

text: For two-wheeled category L vehicles, the reference point for the vehicle immunity test shall be at 0.2 ± 0.2 m behind the vertical centreline of the vehicle's front wheel (point D in Figure 2 of Appendix 1 to Annex 6).
condition: two-wheeled vehicles

text: If it is decided to radiate the rear of a category L vehicle, the reference point shall be established as in paragraphs 3.3.1 to 3.3.4 of Annex 6, and the vehicle shall be installed facing away from the antenna and positioned as if it had been horizontally rotated 180° around its centre point, such that the distance from the antenna to the nearest part of the outer body of the vehicle remains the same.
condition: if it is decided to radiate the rear of the vehicle

text: If a vehicle is longer than 12 m and/or wider than 2.60 m and/or higher than 4.00 m and tested according to ISO 11451-2, additional reference point(s) shall be chosen by the manufacturer in conjunction with the Type Approval Authority after considering the distribution of electronic systems with immunity related functions and the layout of any wiring harness.
condition: vehicle longer than 12 m and/or wider than 2.60 m and/or higher than 4.00 m, tested according to ISO 11451-2

text: In the vehicle immunity test the vehicle shall be exposed to electromagnetic radiation in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges in vertical polarization.
In the vehicle immunity test the test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.
condition: if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and vehicle manufacturer

text: In the vehicle immunity test the test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range.
condition: if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and vehicle manufacturer

text: In the vehicle immunity test the test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
condition: if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and vehicle manufacturer

text: In the vehicle immunity test the frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11451-1.
The Technical Service shall perform the vehicle immunity test at the intervals specified in ISO 11451-1 throughout the frequency range 20 to 6,000 MHz.

The Technical Service may choose a reduced number of spot frequencies in the range (e.g. 27, 45, 65, 90, 120, 150, 190, 230, 280, 380, 450, 600, 750, 900, 1,300, 1,800, 2,360, 2,600, 3,000, 3,600, 5,200 and 5,900 MHz) to confirm that the vehicle meets the requirements of Annex 6 only if the manufacturer provides measurement data for the whole frequency band from a test laboratory accredited to the applicable parts of ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type Approval Authority.
condition: if the manufacturer provides measurement data for the whole frequency band from an accredited and recognized laboratory

text: In configuration REESS charging mode, the Technical Service may perform the vehicle immunity test only for one charging mode configuration and for a reduced number of spot frequencies only if the manufacturer provides measurement data for the whole frequency band from a test laboratory accredited to the applicable parts of ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type-Approval Authority for all the charging mode configurations.
condition: REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid; manufacturer provides accredited measurement data for all charging mode configurations
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: If a vehicle fails the immunity test defined in Annex 6, it shall be verified as having failed under the relevant test conditions and not as a result of the generation of uncontrolled fields.
condition: if a vehicle fails the test

text: The substitution method according to ISO 11451-1 shall be used to establish the test field conditions for the vehicle immunity test.
For calibration with a TLS, four horizontal field probes shall be used.
condition: TLS used

text: For calibration with antennas, four field probes at the vehicle reference line shall be used.
condition: antennas used

text: In the test phase, the vehicle shall be positioned with the centre line of the vehicle on the vehicle reference point or line and shall normally face a fixed antenna.

Where electronic control units with immunity related functions and the associated wiring harness are predominantly in the rear half of the vehicle, the test should normally be carried out with the vehicle facing away from the antenna and positioned as if horizontally rotated 180° around its centre point, such that the distance from the antenna to the nearest part of the outer body of the vehicle remains the same.
condition: ECUs with immunity related functions and associated harness predominantly in the rear half of the vehicle

text: For large vehicles whose electronic control units with immunity related functions and associated wiring harness are not located in the region illuminated at the default reference point, additional reference point(s) may be established; these shall be chosen by the manufacturer in conjunction with the Type Approval Authority after considering the distribution of electronic systems and the layout of any wiring harness, and such testing may only take place if the physical construction of the chamber permits.
condition: large vehicles with ECUs/harness outside the region illuminated at the default reference point

text: The antenna location shall be noted in the test report of the vehicle immunity test.
The measurement of radiated broadband electromagnetic emissions from ESAs shall be performed according to CISPR 25, if not otherwise stated in Annex 7.
During the broadband emission test, the ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
During the broadband emission test, ESAs involved in REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid shall be in charging mode.
condition: ESA involved in REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: During the broadband emission test of an ESA in charging mode, the state of charge (SOC) of the traction battery shall be kept between 20 per cent and 80 per cent of the maximum SOC during the whole frequency range measurement.
condition: ESA involved in REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: If the broadband emission test is not performed with a REESS, the charging ESA should be tested at rated current.
condition: test not performed with a REESS
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For AC charging, if the current consumption can be adjusted, the ESA current shall be set to at least 80 per cent of its maximum rated charging/input current value during the broadband emission test.
condition: AC charging and current consumption adjustable
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For DC charging, if the current consumption can be adjusted, the ESA current shall be set to at least 20 per cent of its nominal value or to a minimum of 16 A (if the 20 per cent of its nominal value cannot be achieved in the test facility) during the broadband emission test, unless another value is agreed with the type approval authorities.
condition: DC charging and current consumption adjustable
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For ESAs other than those involved in REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid, the broadband emission test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in Clause 6.4 of CISPR 25.
condition: ESA not involved in REESS charging mode

text: For ESAs in configuration REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid, the broadband emission test arrangement shall be according to Figure 2 of the appendix to Annex 7.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For the broadband emission test of charging ESAs, the shielding configuration shall be according to the vehicle series configuration, and all shielded HV parts shall be properly connected with low impedance to ground (e.g. AN, cables, connectors).
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For the broadband emission test of charging ESAs, ESAs and loads shall be connected to ground.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For the broadband emission test of charging ESAs, the external HV power supply shall be connected via feed-through-filtering.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For the broadband emission test of charging ESAs, DC HV supply shall be applied to the ESA via a 5 μH/50 Ω HV-AN (see Appendix 8, paragraph 2).
condition: ESA with DC HV supply
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For the broadband emission test of charging ESAs, AC supply shall be applied to the ESA via a 50 μH/50 Ω AMN (see Appendix 8, paragraph 4).
condition: ESA with AC supply
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: Unless otherwise specified, the length of the LV harness and the HV harness parallel to the front edge of the ground plane shall be 1,500 mm (±75 mm) in the broadband emission test of charging ESAs.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: Unless otherwise specified, the total length of the test harness including the connector shall be 1,700 mm (+300/-0 mm) in the broadband emission test of charging ESAs.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: Unless otherwise specified, the distance between the LV harness and the HV harness shall be 100 mm (+100/-0 mm) in the broadband emission test of charging ESAs.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: All of the harnesses shall be placed on a non-conductive, low relative permittivity material (εr ≤ 1.4), at 50 mm (±5 mm) above the ground plane in the broadband emission test of charging ESAs.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: Unless otherwise specified, the ESA case shall be connected to the ground plane either directly or via defined impedance in the broadband emission test of charging ESAs.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For onboard chargers, the AC/DC power lines shall be placed the furthest from the antenna (behind LV and HV harness), at a distance of 100 mm (+100/-0 mm) from the closest harness (LV or HV).
condition: onboard chargers
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: As an alternative to an ALSE, an open area test site (OATS) may be used for the ESA broadband emission test only if it complies with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4.
condition: if OATS is used

text: Ambient measurements shall be taken before or after the main ESA broadband emission test, and the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.5.2.1, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.
The ESA broadband emission limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an ALSE or OATS.

If peak detectors are used for the ESA broadband emission measurement, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied, since the limits of paragraphs 6.5 and 7.10 are for quasi-peak detectors.
condition: peak detectors used

text: The ESA broadband emission measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver using the parameters defined in Table 1 and Table 2 of Annex 7.
Spectrum analysers and FFT-based instruments may be used for conformity measurements only if they meet the requirements of CISPR 16-1-1.
condition: spectrum analyser or FFT-based instrument used

text: FFT-based measuring instruments shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time, with a minimum measurement time of 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode).
condition: FFT-based instruments used

text: For the spectrum analyser with peak detector in the 30 to 1,000 MHz range, RBW at -3 dB shall be 100/120 kHz with a minimum scan time of 100 ms/MHz.
condition: spectrum analyser, peak detector

text: For the spectrum analyser with quasi-peak detector in the 30 to 1,000 MHz range, RBW at -6 dB shall be 120 kHz with a minimum scan time of 20 s/MHz.
condition: spectrum analyser, quasi-peak detector

text: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video bandwidth shall be at least three times the resolution bandwidth (RBW).
condition: spectrum analyser used for peak measurements

text: For the scanning receiver with peak detector in the 30 to 1,000 MHz range, BW at -6 dB shall be 120 kHz, maximum step size 60 kHz and minimum dwell time 5 ms.
condition: scanning receiver, peak detector

text: For the scanning receiver with quasi-peak detector in the 30 to 1,000 MHz range, BW at -6 dB shall be 120 kHz, maximum step size 60 kHz and minimum dwell time 1 s.
condition: scanning receiver, quasi-peak detector

text: For purely broadband disturbances, the maximum frequency step size may be increased up to a value not greater than the bandwidth value; for emissions generated by brush commutator motors without an electronic control unit, the maximum step size may be increased up to five times the bandwidth.
condition: purely broadband disturbances or brush commutator motors without ECU

text: Unless otherwise specified, the configuration with the LV harness closer to the antenna shall be tested in the ESA broadband emission test.
The phase centre of the antenna shall be in line with the centre of the longitudinal part of the wiring harnesses for frequencies up to 1,000 MHz.
The Technical Service shall perform the ESA broadband emission test at the intervals specified in CISPR 12 throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz.

The Technical Service may divide the frequency range in 14 frequency bands (30-34, 34-45, 45-60, 60-80, 80-100, 100-130, 130-170, 170-225, 225-300, 300-400, 400-525, 525-700, 700-850 and 850-1,000 MHz) and test at the 14 frequencies giving the highest emission levels within each band only if the manufacturer provides measurement data for the whole frequency band from a test laboratory accredited to the applicable parts of ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type Approval Authority.
condition: manufacturer provides accredited measurement data for the whole frequency band

text: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the ESA broadband emission test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation.
condition: limit exceeded during the test

text: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarization) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.
The measurement of radiated narrowband electromagnetic emissions from ESAs shall be performed according to CISPR 25, if not otherwise stated in Annex 8.
condition: ESA other than those involved in REESS charging mode

text: During the narrowband emission test, the ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
The ESA narrowband emission test shall be performed according to the ALSE method described in paragraph 6.4 of CISPR 25.
As an alternative to an ALSE, an open area test site (OATS) may be used for the ESA narrowband emission test only if it complies with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4.
condition: if OATS is used

text: Ambient measurements shall be taken before or after the main ESA narrowband emission test, and the extraneous noise or signal shall be at least 6 dB below the limits of interference given in paragraph 6.6.2.1, except for intentional narrowband ambient transmissions.

For ESA narrowband radiated emission measurements, the limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).
condition: ESA other than those involved in REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: ESA narrowband radiated emission measurements shall be performed with an average detector.

ESA narrowband radiated emission measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver using the parameters defined in Tables 1 and 2; spectrum analysers and FFT-based instruments may be used for conformity measurements only if they meet the requirements of CISPR 16-1-1.

FFT-based measuring instruments shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time, with a minimum measurement time of 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode) of the FFT instrument.
condition: if FFT-based instruments are used

text: For ESA narrowband emission measurements with a spectrum analyser in the 30 to 1,000 MHz range, the average detector shall use an RBW at -3 dB of 100/120 kHz and a minimum scan time of 100 ms/MHz.
condition: if a spectrum analyser is used

text: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video bandwidth shall be at least three times the resolution bandwidth (RBW).
condition: if a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements

text: For ESA narrowband emission measurements with a scanning receiver in the 30 to 1,000 MHz range, the average detector shall use a BW at -6 dB of 120 kHz, a maximum step size of 60 kHz and a minimum dwell time of 5 ms.
condition: if a scanning receiver is used

text: The Technical Service shall perform the ESA narrowband emission test at the intervals specified in the CISPR 12 standard throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz.

The Technical Service may divide the frequency range in 14 frequency bands 30-34, 34-45, 45-60, 60-80, 80-100, 100-130, 130-170, 170-225, 225-300, 300-400, 400-525, 525-700, 700-850 and 850-1,000 MHz and perform tests at the 14 frequencies giving the highest emission levels within each band to confirm that the ESA meets the requirements, only if the manufacturer provides measurement data for the whole frequency band from a test laboratory accredited to the applicable parts of ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type Approval Authority.
condition: if the manufacturer provides measurement data for the whole frequency band from an accredited and recognized laboratory

text: In the event that the limit is exceeded during the ESA narrowband emission test, investigations shall be made to ensure that this is due to the ESA and not to background radiation including broadband radiation from the ESA.
condition: if the limit is exceeded during the test

text: The maximum of the readings relative to the limit (horizontal/vertical polarisation) in each of the 14 frequency bands shall be taken as the characteristic reading at the frequency at which the measurements were made.

ESAs may comply with the radiated immunity requirements by any combination of the absorber chamber test (ISO 11452-2), TEM cell testing (ISO 11452-3), bulk current injection testing (ISO 11452-4), stripline testing (ISO 11452-5) and reverberation chamber test (ISO 11452-11) at the manufacturer's discretion, provided that the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of Annex 9 is covered.
condition: ESA other than in REESS charging mode configuration

text: ESAs in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" shall comply with the requirements of the combination of the absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2 and bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4 at the manufacturer's discretion, provided that the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of Annex 9 is covered.
condition: ESA in configuration REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: Frequency range and general test conditions for ESA radiated immunity tests shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
The test conditions for ESA immunity to electromagnetic radiation shall be according to ISO 11452-1.
The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition, and shall be arranged as defined in Annex 9 unless individual test methods dictate otherwise.
For ESAs involved in REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid, the REESS shall be in charging mode during the immunity test.
condition: ESA in configuration REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: The state of charge (SOC) of the traction battery shall be kept between 20 per cent and 80 per cent of the maximum SOC during the whole time duration of the measurement; in case of multiple batteries the average state of charge shall be considered.
condition: ESA in configuration REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: For AC charging, if the current consumption can be adjusted, the current shall be set to at least 20 per cent of its maximum rated charging/input current value.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode with AC charging and adjustable current consumption

text: For DC charging, if the current consumption can be adjusted, the current shall be set to at least 20 per cent of its nominal value or to a minimum of 16 A (if the 20 per cent of its nominal value cannot be achieved in the test facility) unless another value is agreed with the Type-Approval Authorities.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode with DC charging and adjustable current consumption

text: During the radiated immunity test of an ESA in REESS charging mode, temporary loss of charging function is allowed only provided that there is no incorrect charging condition (e.g. over-current, overvoltage) and the function can be restored by a simple intervention, without the use of tools, such as turning off/on the DUT, after the disturbance is removed.
condition: ESA in configuration REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid

text: Any extraneous equipment required to operate the ESA under test shall not be in place during the calibration phase, and no extraneous equipment shall be closer than 1 m from the reference point during calibration.
The test signal generating equipment and its layout shall be to the same specification as that used during each appropriate calibration phase.

If the ESA under test consists of more than one unit, the interconnecting cables should ideally be the wiring harnesses as intended for use in the vehicle; if these are not available, the length between the electronic control unit and the AN shall be as defined in the standard.
condition: if the ESA consists of more than one unit

text: All cables in the wiring harness of the ESA under test should be terminated as realistically as possible and preferably with real loads and actuators.
ESA radiated immunity measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps, step size and dwell time chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
The test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation) with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.
condition: if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer

text: The test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range.
condition: if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer

text: The test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
condition: if not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer

text: The Technical Service shall perform the ESA radiated immunity test at the intervals specified in ISO 11452-1 throughout the frequency range 20 to 6,000 MHz.

The Technical Service may choose a reduced number of spot frequencies in the range (e.g. 27, 45, 65, 90, 120, 150, 190, 230, 280, 380, 450, 600, 750, 900, 1,300, 1,800, 2,360, 2,600, 3,000, 3,600, 5,200 and 5,900 MHz) to confirm that the ESA meets the requirements only if the manufacturer provides measurement data for the whole frequency band from a test laboratory accredited to the applicable parts of ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type Approval Authority.
condition: if the manufacturer provides measurement data for the whole frequency band from an accredited and recognized laboratory

text: If an ESA fails the radiated immunity tests, it shall be verified as having failed under the relevant test conditions and not as a result of the generation of uncontrolled fields.
condition: if an ESA fails the tests

text: In the absorber chamber test, the "substitution method" shall be used to establish the test field conditions according to ISO 11452-2.
condition: if the absorber chamber test is used

text: The absorber chamber test shall be performed with vertical polarization.
condition: if the absorber chamber test is used

text: For ESAs in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" the absorber chamber test arrangement shall be according to Appendix 3 to Annex 9.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode configuration, absorber chamber test

text: In the absorber chamber test of ESAs in REESS charging mode, the shielding configuration shall be according to the vehicle series configuration.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode configuration, absorber chamber test

text: In the absorber chamber test of ESAs in REESS charging mode, all shielded HV parts shall generally be properly connected with low impedance to ground (e.g. AN, cables, connectors etc.), and ESAs and loads shall be connected to ground.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode configuration, absorber chamber test

text: In the absorber chamber test of ESAs in REESS charging mode, the external HV power supply shall be connected via feed-through-filtering.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode configuration, absorber chamber test

text: Unless otherwise specified, the length of the LV harness and the HV harness parallel to the front edge of the ground plane shall be 1,500 mm (±75 mm).
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode configuration, absorber chamber test, unless otherwise specified

text: Unless otherwise specified, the total length of the test harness including the connector shall be 1,700 mm (+300/-0 mm).
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode configuration, absorber chamber test, unless otherwise specified

text: Unless otherwise specified, the distance between the LV harness and the HV harness shall be 100 mm (+100/-0 mm).
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode configuration, absorber chamber test, unless otherwise specified

text: All of the harnesses shall be placed on a non-conductive, low relative permittivity material (εr ≤ 1,4), at 50 mm (±5 mm) above the ground plane.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode configuration, absorber chamber test

text: Shielded supply lines for HV+ and HV- line and three phase lines may be coaxial cables or in a common shield depending on the used plug system; the original HV-harness from the vehicle may be used optionally.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode configuration, absorber chamber test

text: Unless otherwise specified, the ESA case shall be connected to the ground plane either directly or via defined impedance.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode configuration, absorber chamber test, unless otherwise specified

text: For onboard chargers, the AC/DC power lines shall be placed the furthest from the antenna (behind LV and HV harness).
condition: onboard chargers, absorber chamber test

text: For onboard chargers, the distance between the AC/DC power lines and the closest harness (LV or HV) shall be 100 mm (+100/-0 mm).
condition: onboard chargers, absorber chamber test

text: Unless otherwise specified, the configuration with the LV harness closer to the antenna shall be tested.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode configuration, absorber chamber test, unless otherwise specified

text: TEM cell testing shall be performed according to ISO 11452-3.
condition: if TEM cell testing is used

text: Depending on the ESA to be tested, the Technical Service shall choose the method of maximum field coupling to the ESA or to the wiring harness inside the TEM-cell.
condition: if TEM cell testing is used

text: Bulk current injection testing shall be performed according to ISO 11452-4 on a test bench either with the BCI substitution method and the injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA, or with the BCI closed loop method and the injection probe positioned at 900 mm distance to the ESA.
condition: if bulk current injection testing is used

text: As an alternative, the ESA may be tested while installed in the vehicle according to ISO 11451-4 with the BCI substitution method and the injection probe positioned at 150 mm distance to the ESA.
condition: if BCI testing is performed with the ESA installed in the vehicle

text: In BCI testing of ESAs in REESS charging mode, the shielding configuration shall be according to the vehicle series configuration.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode configuration, BCI test

text: In BCI testing of ESAs in REESS charging mode, all shielded HV parts shall generally be properly connected with low impedance to ground (e.g. AN, cables, connectors, etc.), and ESAs and loads shall be connected to ground.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode configuration, BCI test

text: In BCI testing of ESAs in REESS charging mode, the external HV power supply shall be connected via feed-through-filtering.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode configuration, BCI test

text: When using the substitution method, unless otherwise specified, the length of the LV harness and the HV harness shall be 1,700 mm (+300/-0 mm) and the distance between the LV harness and the HV harness shall be 100 mm (+100/-0 mm).
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode configuration, BCI substitution method, unless otherwise specified

text: The HV/LV wiring harness shall be straight over at least 1,400 mm starting at the ESA for all test methods defined in part 4 of ISO 11452 except for the BCI test method using the closed-loop method with power limitation.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode configuration, BCI test other than closed-loop with power limitation

text: When using the closed loop method, unless otherwise specified, the length of the LV harness and the HV harness shall be 1,000 mm (+200/-0 mm) and the distance between the LV harness and the HV harness shall be 100 mm (+100/-0 mm).
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode configuration, BCI closed loop method, unless otherwise specified

text: The HV/LV wiring harness shall be straight over its entire length for the BCI test method using the closed-loop method with power limitation.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode configuration, BCI closed-loop method with power limitation

text: In BCI testing, all of the harnesses shall be placed on a non-conductive, low relative permittivity material (εr ≤ 1.4), at (50 ± 5) mm above the ground plane.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode configuration, BCI test

text: In BCI testing, shielded supply lines for HV+ and HV- line and three phase lines may be coaxial cables or in a common shield depending on the used plug system; the original HV-harness from the vehicle may be used optionally.

text: In BCI testing, unless otherwise specified, the ESA case shall be connected to the ground plane either directly or via defined impedance.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode configuration, BCI test, unless otherwise specified

text: Unless otherwise specified, the BCI test shall be performed with the injection probe placed around the low voltage harness.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode configuration, BCI test, unless otherwise specified

text: Unless otherwise specified, the BCI test shall be performed with the injection probe placed around the high voltage harness.
condition: ESA in REESS charging mode configuration, BCI test, unless otherwise specified

text: Unless otherwise specified, the BCI test shall be performed with the injection probe placed around the AC power lines.
condition: if applicable (ESA with AC power lines), unless otherwise specified

text: Unless otherwise specified, the BCI test shall be performed with the injection probe placed around the DC power lines.
condition: if applicable (ESA with DC power lines), unless otherwise specified

text: Stripline testing shall be performed according to ISO 11452-5.
condition: if stripline testing is used

text: The reverberation chamber test shall be performed according to ISO 11452-11.
condition: if reverberation chamber testing is used

text: Unless otherwise specified, the reverberation chamber testing method shall be carried out using a test setup with ground plane.
condition: if reverberation chamber testing is used, unless otherwise specified

condition: ESA in REESS charging mode configuration

text: The test method of Annex 10 shall ensure the immunity of ESAs to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply.
The test method of Annex 10 shall limit conducted transients from ESAs to the vehicle power supply.

For immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
The starting profile according to ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
condition: not applicable to ESAs exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor)

text: Emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by ESAs on 12/24 V supply lines shall be measured according to ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as on other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
The harmonics emission test method of Annex 11 shall be applied to vehicles in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid".

text: The vehicle harmonics emission test shall be performed according to IEC 61000-3-2 for input current in charging mode ≤ 16 A per phase for class A equipment.

text: The vehicle harmonics emission test shall be performed according to IEC 61000-3-12 for input current in charging mode > 16 A and ≤ 75 A per phase.

applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: During the harmonics test the vehicle shall be in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" and tested in the charging mode configuration (if available on vehicle) as defined in the flowchart of Figure 1.

text: For two-wheeled vehicles, a non-conductive insulating support with a thickness of 5 – 20 mm shall be used between stand and ground plane during the harmonics test.
condition: two-wheeled vehicles
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The state of charge (SOC) of the traction battery shall be kept between 20 per cent and 80 per cent of the maximum SOC during the whole time duration of the harmonics measurement; in case of multiple batteries the average state of charge shall be considered.

condition: if the current consumption can be adjusted
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: During the harmonics test the vehicle shall be immobilized, the engine(s) (ICE and/or electrical engine) shall be OFF and in charging mode, and all other equipment which can be switched ON by the driver or passengers shall be OFF.

text: The observation time used for the vehicle harmonics measurements shall be as for quasi-stationary equipment as defined in IEC 61000-3-2, Table 4.
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The test set-up for single phase / three-phase vehicle in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" shall be as shown in Figures 1a to 1d of Appendix 1 to Annex 11.

text: The measurements of even and odd current harmonics shall be performed up to the 40th harmonic.

applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

condition: balanced three-phase; input current > 16 A and ≤ 75 A per phase
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For three-phase vehicles in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" with input current > 16 A and ≤ 75 A per phase, the limits of Table 7 of paragraph 7.3.2.2. may be applied only when at least one of the conditions a), b) or c) of Clause 5.2 of IEC 61000-3-12 is fulfilled.
condition: three-phase, input current > 16 A and ≤ 75 A per phase, and at least one of conditions a), b) or c) of IEC 61000-3-12 Clause 5.2 fulfilled
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The voltage changes, voltage fluctuations and flicker test method of Annex 12 shall be applied to vehicles in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid".
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The vehicle flicker test shall be performed according to IEC 61000-3-3 for rated current in "REESS charging mode" ≤ 16 A per phase and not subjected to conditional connection.
condition: rated current ≤ 16 A per phase, not subjected to conditional connection; if not otherwise stated in Annex 12
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The vehicle flicker test shall be performed according to IEC 61000-3-11 for rated current in "REESS charging mode" > 16 A and ≤ 75 A per phase and subjected to conditional connection.
condition: rated current > 16 A and ≤ 75 A per phase, subjected to conditional connection; if not otherwise stated in Annex 12
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For two-wheeled vehicles, a non-conductive insulating support with a thickness of 5 – 20 mm shall be used between stand and ground plane during the flicker test.
condition: two-wheeled vehicles
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The state of charge (SOC) of the traction battery shall be kept between 20 per cent and 80 per cent of the maximum SOC during the whole time duration of the flicker measurement; in case of multiple batteries the average state of charge shall be considered.

condition: if the current consumption can be adjusted
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: During the flicker test the vehicle shall be immobilized, the engine(s) (ICE and/or electrical engine) shall be OFF and in charging mode, and all other equipment which can be switched ON by the driver or passengers shall be OFF.
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The flicker tests for vehicles in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" with rated current ≤ 16 A per phase and not subjected to conditional connection shall be performed according to Clause 6 of IEC 61000-3-3.
condition: rated current ≤ 16 A per phase, not subjected to conditional connection
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The flicker tests for vehicles in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" with rated current > 16 A and ≤ 75 A per phase and subjected to conditional connection shall be performed according to Clause 6 of IEC 61000-3-11.
condition: rated current > 16 A and ≤ 75 A per phase, subjected to conditional connection
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The flicker test set-up for vehicles in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" shall be as shown in Figures 1a to 1d of Appendix 1 to Annex 12.
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The parameters "short duration flicker value", "long duration flicker value" and "voltage relative variation" shall be determined in the time-domain.
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For vehicles in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" with input current ≤ 16 A per phase and not subjected to conditional connection, the flicker limits of paragraph 7.4.2.1. shall apply.
condition: input current ≤ 16 A per phase, not subjected to conditional connection
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For vehicles in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" with input current > 16 A and ≤ 75 A per phase and subjected to conditional connection, the flicker limits of paragraph 7.4.2.2. shall apply.
condition: input current > 16 A and ≤ 75 A per phase, subjected to conditional connection
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The radiofrequency conducted disturbances test method of Annex 13 shall be applied to vehicles in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid".
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: If not otherwise stated in Annex 13, the vehicle RF conducted disturbance test on AC or DC power lines shall be performed according to CISPR 16-2-1.
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: During the RF conducted emission test the vehicle shall be in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" and tested in the charging mode configuration (if available on vehicle) as defined in the flowchart of Figure 1.
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For two-wheeled vehicles, a non-conductive insulating support with a thickness of 5 – 20 mm shall be used between stand and ground plane during the RF conducted emission test.
condition: two-wheeled vehicles
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The state of charge (SOC) of the traction battery shall be kept between 20 per cent and 80 per cent of the maximum SOC during the whole frequency range measurement; in case of multiple batteries the average state of charge shall be considered.
If the current consumption can be adjusted, the current shall be set to at least 80 per cent of its maximum rated charging/input current value for AC charging during the RF conducted emission test.

applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

condition: if the current consumption can be adjusted; DC charging
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The vehicle RF conducted emission test shall be performed according to Clause 7.4.1 of CISPR 16-2-1 as floor-standing equipment.

applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The AMN(s)/DC-charging-AN(s) shall be mounted directly on the ground plane and their cases shall be bonded to the ground plane.
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The conducted emissions on AC and DC power lines shall be measured successively on each power line by connecting the measuring receiver on the measuring port of the related AMN/DC-charging-AN, and the measuring port of the AMN/DC-charging-AN inserted in the other power line shall be terminated with a 50 Ω load.
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The AMN(s)/DC-charging-AN(s) shall be placed as defined in Figures 1a to 1d of Appendix 1 to Annex 13.
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The test set-up for the connection of the vehicle in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" shall be as shown in Figures 1a to 1d of Appendix 1 to Annex 13.
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The vehicle RF conducted emission measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver; spectrum analysers and FFT-based instruments may be used for conformity measurements only if they meet the requirements of CISPR 16-1-1.
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: FFT-based measuring instruments shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time, with a minimum measurement time of 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode).
condition: if FFT-based instruments are used
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: Spectrum analyser parameters in the 0.15 to 30 MHz range shall be: peak detector RBW at -3 dB 9/10 kHz with minimum scan time 10 s/MHz; quasi-peak detector RBW at -6 dB 9 kHz with minimum scan time 200 s/MHz; average detector RBW at -3 dB 9/10 kHz with minimum scan time 10 s/MHz.
condition: if a spectrum analyser is used
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

condition: spectrum analyser used for peak measurements
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: Scanning receiver parameters in the 0.15 to 30 MHz range shall be: peak detector BW at -6 dB 9 kHz, maximum step size 5 kHz, minimum dwell time 50 ms; quasi-peak detector BW 9 kHz, maximum step 5 kHz, minimum dwell time 1 s; average detector BW 9 kHz, maximum step 5 kHz, minimum dwell time 50 ms.
condition: if a scanning receiver is used
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The vehicle RF conducted emission limits apply throughout the frequency range 0.15 to 30 MHz for measurements performed in a shielded enclosure, ALSE or OATS.
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: Vehicle RF conducted emission measurements shall be performed with average and either quasi-peak or peak detectors, against the limits of paragraph 7.5. (Table 8 for AC lines and Table 9 for DC lines).
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: If peak detectors are used, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.
condition: if peak detectors are used
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

condition: manufacturer provides accredited laboratory data for all charging mode configurations
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The vehicle shall be subject to electrical fast transient/burst disturbances conducted along its AC and DC power lines and shall be monitored during the tests; if not otherwise stated, the test shall be performed according to IEC 61000-4-4.

text: For the EFT/burst test the vehicle shall be tested in the charging mode configuration (if available on vehicle) as defined in the flowchart of Figure 1.
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For the EFT/burst test the vehicle shall be in an unladen condition except for necessary test equipment.
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For the EFT/burst test the vehicle shall be immobilized, the engine(s) (ICE and/or electrical engine) shall be OFF and in charging mode.
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: Other vehicle systems which can affect immunity related functions shall be tested in a way to be agreed between manufacturer and Technical Service during the EFT/burst test.

If the current consumption can be adjusted, the current shall be set to at least 20 per cent of its maximum rated charging/input current value for AC charging during the EFT/burst test.
condition: if the current consumption can be adjusted; AC charging
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: If the current consumption can be adjusted, the current shall be set to at least 20 per cent of its nominal value or to a minimum of 16 A (if the 20 per cent of its nominal value cannot be achieved in the test facility) for DC charging, unless another value is agreed with the Type Approval Authorities.
condition: if the current consumption can be adjusted; DC charging
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: During the EFT/burst test in REESS charging mode the vehicle shall not set in motion, shall not exhibit unexpected release of the parking brake, and shall not lose Parking position for automatic transmission (failure criteria).

applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The Coupling/Decoupling Network shall meet the condition defined in Clause 6.2 of IEC 61000-4-4; the capacitive coupling clamp defined in Clause 6.3 of IEC 61000-4-4 may be used only when the CDN cannot be used on AC or DC power lines.
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For single phase or other than balanced three-phase ESAs in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" with input current > 16 A and ≤ 75 A per phase, the harmonics shall meet the limits given in Table 13 of paragraph 7.11.2.2.
condition: single phase or other than balanced three-phase; input current > 16 A and ≤ 75 A per phase
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For balanced three-phase ESAs in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" with input current > 16 A and ≤ 75 A per phase, the harmonics shall meet the limits given in Table 14 of paragraph 7.11.2.2.
condition: balanced three-phase; input current > 16 A and ≤ 75 A per phase
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For three-phase ESAs in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" with input current > 16 A and ≤ 75 A per phase, the limits given in Table 15 of paragraph 7.11.2.2. can be applied when at least one of the three conditions a), b) or c) described in Clause 5.2 of IEC 61000-3-12 is fulfilled.
condition: three-phase; input current > 16 A and ≤ 75 A per phase; at least one of conditions a), b) or c) of IEC 61000-3-12 Clause 5.2 fulfilled
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The voltage changes, voltage fluctuations and flicker test method of Annex 18 shall be applied to ESAs in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid".
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: If not otherwise stated in Annex 18, the ESA flicker test shall be performed according to IEC 61000-3-3 for rated current in "REESS charging mode" ≤ 16 A per phase and not subjected to conditional connection.
condition: rated current ≤ 16 A per phase and not subjected to conditional connection

text: If not otherwise stated in Annex 18, the ESA flicker test shall be performed according to IEC 61000-3-11 for rated current in "REESS charging mode" > 16 A and ≤ 75 A per phase and subjected to conditional connection.
condition: rated current > 16 A and ≤ 75 A per phase and subjected to conditional connection

text: During the flicker test, the ESA shall be in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid".
During the ESA flicker test, the state of charge (SOC) of the traction battery shall be kept between 20 per cent and 80 per cent of the maximum SOC during the whole time duration of the measurement.
During the ESA flicker test, the current shall be set to at least 80 per cent of its maximum rated charging/input current value for AC charging.
condition: if the current consumption can be adjusted; AC charging

text: The flicker tests for ESA in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" with rated current ≤ 16 A per phase and not subjected to conditional connection shall be performed according to Clause 4 of IEC 61000-3-3.
condition: rated current ≤ 16 A per phase and not subjected to conditional connection

text: The flicker tests for ESA in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" with rated current > 16 A and ≤ 75 A per phase and subjected to conditional connection shall be performed according to Clause 6 of IEC 61000-3-11.
condition: rated current > 16 A and ≤ 75 A per phase and subjected to conditional connection

text: The flicker test set-up for ESA in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" shall be as shown in Figures 1a and 1b of Appendix 1 to Annex 18.
The parameters "short duration flicker value", "long duration flicker value" and "voltage relative variation" shall be determined in the time-domain for the ESA.

For ESA in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" with input current ≤ 16 A per phase and not subjected to conditional connection, voltage changes, fluctuations and flicker shall meet the limits given in paragraph 7.12.2.1.
condition: input current ≤ 16 A per phase and not subjected to conditional connection
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: For ESA in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" with input current > 16 A and ≤ 75 A per phase and subjected to conditional connection, voltage changes, fluctuations and flicker shall meet the limits given in paragraph 7.12.2.2.
condition: input current > 16 A and ≤ 75 A per phase and subjected to conditional connection
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The radiofrequency conducted emission test method of Annex 19 shall be applied to ESAs in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid".
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: If not otherwise stated in Annex 19, the ESA radiofrequency conducted emission test on AC or DC power lines shall be performed according to CISPR 16-2-1.
During the RF conducted emission test, the ESA shall be in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid".

During the ESA RF conducted emission test, the state of charge (SOC) of the traction battery shall be kept between 20 per cent and 80 per cent of the maximum SOC during the whole frequency range measurement.
If the RF conducted emission test is not performed with a REESS, the ESA should be tested at rated current.
condition: test not performed with a REESS

text: During the ESA RF conducted emission test, the current shall be set to at least 80 per cent of its maximum rated charging/input current value for AC charging.
condition: if the current consumption can be adjusted; AC charging

text: During the ESA RF conducted emission test, the current shall be set to at least 20 per cent of its nominal value or to a minimum of 16 A (if the 20 per cent of its nominal value cannot be achieved in the test facility) for DC charging unless another value is agreed with the Type Approval Authorities.
condition: if the current consumption can be adjusted; DC charging

text: The AMN(s) defined in Appendix 8, paragraph 4. shall be used for AC power lines and the DC-charging-AN(s) defined in Appendix 8, paragraph 3. for DC power lines in the ESA RF conducted emission measurement.
The AMN(s)/DC-charging-AN(s) shall be mounted directly on the ground plane.
The cases of the AMN(s)/DC-charging-AN(s) shall be bonded to the ground plane.

The conducted emissions on AC and DC power lines shall be measured successively on each power line by connecting the measuring receiver on the measuring port of the related AMN/DC-charging-AN, and the measuring port of the AMN/DC-charging-AN inserted in the other power lines shall be terminated with a 50 Ω load.
The AMN(s)/DC-charging-AN(s) shall be placed in front, aligned and on the same side of the power charging plug.

The ESA RF conducted emission measuring location shall be a shielded enclosure, an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or an open area test site (OATS) which complies with the requirements of CISPR 16-1-4.
The test set-up (floor-standing equipment) for the connection of the ESAs in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" shall be as shown in Figure 1 of Appendix 1 to Annex 19.

The ESA RF conducted emission measurements shall be performed with a spectrum analyser or a scanning receiver using the parameters defined in Table 1 and Table 2; spectrum analysers and FFT-based instruments meeting the requirements of CISPR 16-1-1 may be used for conformity measurements.
FFT-based measuring instruments shall continuously record and evaluate the signal during the measurement time, with a minimum measurement time of 1 s per analysis frequency band (in real-time mode).
condition: if FFT-based instruments are used

text: Spectrum analyser parameters for 0.15 to 30 MHz: peak detector RBW at -3 dB 9/10 kHz, minimum scan time 10 s/MHz; quasi-peak detector RBW at -6 dB 9 kHz, minimum scan time 200 s/MHz; average detector RBW at -3 dB 9/10 kHz, minimum scan time 10 s/MHz.
condition: if a spectrum analyser is used

text: If a spectrum analyser is used for peak measurements, the video bandwidth shall be at least three times the resolution bandwidth (RBW).
condition: spectrum analyser used for peak measurements

text: Scanning receiver parameters for 0.15 to 30 MHz: peak detector BW at -6 dB 9 kHz, maximum step size 5 kHz, minimum dwell time 50 ms; quasi-peak detector BW 9 kHz, step 5 kHz, dwell 1 s; average detector BW 9 kHz, step 5 kHz, dwell 50 ms.
condition: if a scanning receiver is used

text: The limits for radiofrequency conducted disturbances on AC or DC power lines from ESAs apply throughout the frequency range 0.15 to 30 MHz for measurements performed in a shielded enclosure or an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or an open area test site (OATS).
condition: ESA in configuration REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: Measurements of radiofrequency conducted disturbances on AC or DC power lines from ESAs shall be performed with average and either quasi-peak or peak detectors.
condition: ESA in configuration REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The ESA radiofrequency conducted disturbances shall meet the limits given in Table 16 of paragraph 7.13.2.1. for AC lines.
condition: ESA with AC power lines in configuration REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The ESA radiofrequency conducted disturbances shall meet the limits given in Table 17 of paragraph 7.13.2.2. for DC lines.
condition: ESA with DC power lines in configuration REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: If peak detectors are used for measuring ESA radiofrequency conducted disturbances, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.
condition: if peak detectors are used
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The test method for immunity to electrical fast transient/burst disturbances conducted along AC and DC power lines described in Annex 21 shall only be applied to ESAs, and only to ESAs in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid".
condition: ESA in configuration REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The ESA shall be subject to Electrical Fast Transient/Burst disturbances conducted along its AC and DC power lines as described in Annex 21.
condition: ESA in configuration REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The ESA shall be monitored during the Electrical Fast Transient/Burst immunity tests.
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: If not otherwise stated in Annex 21, the ESA Electrical Fast Transient/Burst immunity test shall be performed according to IEC 61000-4-4.
condition: if not otherwise stated in Annex 21
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: During the Electrical Fast Transient/Burst immunity test the ESA shall be in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid".

During the ESA Electrical Fast Transient/Burst immunity test, the state of charge (SOC) of the traction battery shall be kept between 20 per cent and 80 per cent of the maximum SOC during the whole time duration of the measurement.

For AC charging, if the current consumption can be adjusted, the ESA current shall be set to at least 20 per cent of its maximum rated charging/input current value during the Electrical Fast Transient/Burst immunity test.
condition: AC charging and current consumption can be adjusted

text: For DC charging, if the current consumption can be adjusted, the ESA current shall be set to at least 20 per cent of its nominal value or to a minimum of 16 A (if the 20 per cent of its nominal value cannot be achieved in the test facility) during the Electrical Fast Transient/Burst immunity test, unless another value is agreed with the Type Approval Authorities.
condition: DC charging and current consumption can be adjusted, unless another value is agreed with the Type Approval Authorities

text: During the Electrical Fast Transient/Burst immunity test, temporary loss of the ESA charging function is allowed only provided that there is no incorrect charging condition (e.g. over-current, overvoltage) and the function can be restored by a simple intervention, without the use of tools, such as turning off/on the DUT, after the disturbance is removed.
Only non-perturbing equipment shall be used while monitoring the ESA during the Electrical Fast Transient/Burst immunity test.
The ESA shall be monitored to determine whether the requirements of Annex 21 are met (e.g. by using video camera(s), a microphone, etc.).

The test equipment for the ESA Electrical Fast Transient/Burst immunity test shall be composed of a reference ground plane (a shielded room is not required), a transient/burst generator, a Coupling/Decoupling Network (CDN) and a capacitive coupling clamp.
The transient/burst generator shall meet the condition defined in Clause 6.1 of IEC 61000-4-4.
The Coupling/Decoupling Network shall meet the condition defined in Clause 6.2 of IEC 61000-4-4.
The capacitive coupling clamp defined in Clause 6.3 of IEC 61000-4-4 may be used only when the Coupling/Decoupling Network cannot be used on AC or DC power lines.
condition: when the CDN cannot be used on AC or DC power lines

text: The ESA Electrical Fast Transient/Burst test set-up shall be based on the laboratory type set-up as described in Clause 7.2 of IEC 61000-4-4.
For the Electrical Fast Transient/Burst immunity test, the ESA shall be placed directly on the ground plane.

The Technical Service shall perform the ESA Electrical Fast Transient/Burst immunity test as specified in paragraph 7.15.2.1.; the Technical Service may choose not to perform the test only if the manufacturer provides measurement from a test laboratory accredited to the applicable parts of ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type Approval Authority.
The ESA Electrical Fast Transient/Burst immunity test shall be conducted in accordance with IEC 61000-4-4 and performed only at the severity levels given in paragraph 7.15.2.1.
During the test phase the ESA shall be positioned on the ground plane.
The Electrical Fast Transient/Burst (EFT/B) shall be applied on the ESA on the AC/DC power lines in common modes by using CDN as described in Figure 1 of Appendix 1 to Annex 21.
The ESA Electrical Fast Transient/Burst test set-up shall be noted in the test report.

The test method for immunity to surges conducted along AC and DC power lines described in Annex 22 shall only be applied to ESAs, and only to ESAs in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid".
condition: ESA in configuration REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The ESA shall be subject to surges conducted along its AC and DC power lines as described in Annex 22.
applies_to: coupling system for charging the reess

text: The ESA shall be monitored during the surge immunity tests.
If not otherwise stated in Annex 22, the ESA surge immunity test shall be performed according to IEC 61000-4-5.
condition: if not otherwise stated in Annex 22

text: During the surge immunity test the ESA shall be in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid".

During the ESA surge immunity test, the state of charge (SOC) of the traction battery shall be kept between 20 per cent and 80 per cent of the maximum SOC during the whole frequency range measurement.
If the surge immunity test is not performed with a REESS, the ESA should be tested at rated current.
condition: if the test is not performed with a REESS

text: For AC charging, if the current consumption can be adjusted, the ESA current shall be set to at least 20 per cent of its maximum rated charging/input current value during the surge immunity test.
condition: AC charging and current consumption can be adjusted

text: For DC charging, if the current consumption can be adjusted, the ESA current shall be set to at least 20 per cent of its nominal value or to a minimum of 16 A (if the 20 per cent of its nominal value cannot be achieved in the test facility) during the surge immunity test, unless another value is agreed with the Type-Approval Authorities.
condition: DC charging and current consumption can be adjusted, unless another value is agreed with the Type-Approval Authorities

text: During the surge immunity test, temporary loss of the ESA charging function is allowed only provided that there is no incorrect charging condition (e.g. over-current, overvoltage) and the function can be restored by a simple intervention, without the use of tools, such as turning off/on the DUT, after the disturbance is removed.
Only non-perturbing equipment shall be used while monitoring the ESA during the surge immunity test.
The ESA shall be monitored to determine whether the requirements of Annex 22 are met (e.g. by using video camera(s), a microphone, etc.).
The test equipment for the ESA surge immunity test shall be composed of a reference ground plane (a shielded room is not required), a surge generator and a Coupling/Decoupling Network (CDN).
The surge generator shall meet the condition defined in Clause 6.1 of IEC 61000-4-5.
The Coupling/Decoupling Network shall meet the condition defined in Clause 6.3 of IEC 61000-4-5.
The ESA surge test set-up shall be based on the set-up described in Clause 7.2 of IEC 61000-4-5.
For the surge immunity test, the ESA shall be placed directly on the ground plane.

The Technical Service shall perform the ESA surge immunity test as specified in paragraph 7.16.2.1.; the Technical Service may choose not to perform the test only if the manufacturer provides measurement from a test laboratory accredited to the applicable parts of ISO 17025 and recognized by the Type Approval Authority.
The ESA surge immunity test shall be conducted in accordance with IEC 61000-4-5 and performed only at the severity levels given in paragraph 7.16.2.1.
During the surge test phase the ESA shall be positioned on the ground plane.
The electrical surge shall be applied on the ESA on the AC/DC power lines between each line and earth and between lines by using CDN as described in Figures 1 to 4 of Appendix 1 to Annex 22.
The ESA surge test set-up shall be noted in the test report.
